Title: Digital - Senior Data Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
THE BUSINESS

We are Everyday Luxury™.

It's what we do and how we do it — together.

It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results.

It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture.

It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong.

It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia.

It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity.




With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.




THE TEAM

The mission of the Digital Technology department is to provide the technology foundations, delivery capabilities, and operational excellence that enable Digital to scale with speed and deliver exceptional digital experiences.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Aritzia is growing and our Digital Technology team is growing with it. This is a unique opportunity to join the team responsible for unlocking the value of Aritzia's data and enabling data-driven decision-making across the business. As the Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, you will transform data into actionable insights by partnering with stakeholders to understand key business questions, analyze data, and communicate meaningful recommendations. With the skills you gain in this role, the opportunities are endless – from a rewarding career in Digital Technology to continued growth and development with Aritzia.




THE ROLE

As the Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, Digital Technology, you will:

Partner and innovate with business leaders to deeply understand or identify the strategic opportunities across client acquisition, activation, retention and reactivation
Define measurement strategies to quantify the performance of various customer programs and compare their current condition against a hindsight benchmark
Support with generating actionable insights by analyzing customer behaviour through diagnostics, correlations, and hypothesis testing to grow the business and enhance customer experience
Clearly and accurately visualize and communicate data and analytics through reports, dashboards, and presentations to maximize strategic decisions




THE QUALIFICATIONS

The Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, Digital Technology, has:

Proven skills, education, and/or applicable certifications in:
SQL
Visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent)
Python
R or related statistical analysis and tools
Analyzing and interpreting complex datasets to generate actionable business insights
A commitment to learn, apply, champion and enrich Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles




THE COMPENSATION

At Aritzia, we provide market-leading compensation packages designed to reward impact through our pay-for-performance philosophy.




The range for roles at this level is $50,000-$150,000 per year. Total compensation may include base, bonus and/or equity depending on the role, which has the potential to be greater than this range.




With comprehensive benefits, aspirational workspaces, and elevated perks and experiences — we provide it all.




THE PERKS

Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.
Baby Leave Program — We provide up to 16 weeks of paid time to support you and your growing family.
Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial.
Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration.
Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.
The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like snacks and refreshments, dry-cleaning, hotel, restaurant discounts, health and wellness discounts, and self-care promos.

Title: Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)

Locations: Kirkland, Los Angeles (Hybrid)

Reports to: Director, Advertising & Sponsorships Insights & Innovations

As the Advertising Intelligence Analyst, you will manage monthly reporting deliverables for in-game advertising inventory as well as develop scalable data models and construct essential dashboards for the Ads & Sponsorships (A&S) team. You will partner with AdOps, AdTech, Product Management, and game analytics groups across game studios to ensure reporting data remains precise, documented, and streamlined through automation.

Operating on assignments of moderate complexity, you will independently handle the standard reporting rhythm while collaborating on new projects. You will report directly to the Director of Advertising Intelligence, and collaborate daily with the Data Solutions Analyst. Your contributions will provide foundational insights relied upon by the entire A&S Team.

Responsibilities


Align with the AdOps team each month on which campaigns are included in reporting, then create and consistently publish reports for all custom A&S inventory across EA titles.
Act as the A&S business lead with AdTech on report automation — define requirements, validate output, and cut manual steps out of the monthly cycle.
Collaborate with the Product Management team to ensure new inventory is included in standardized reporting.
Maintain documentation of reporting queries and KPI calculations so results are reproducible and auditable.
Bridge the reporting gap for A&S inventory in mobile titles and work towards automation.
Build and maintain the A&S team dashboards, to support the Sales, AdOps, Product Management, and Revenue Strategy functions.
Manage access and permissions for A&S dashboards.
Apply working knowledge of data engineering concepts to design and maintain internal A&S data models and databases as well as provide inputs and guidance to AdTech partners on data pipeline migration.
Build partnerships with studio analytics teams to understand each team's data taxonomy.
Fulfill ad hoc telemetry and data requests across the A&S team.


Qualifications


1+ years of experience in analytics, reporting, or business intelligence; internship experience counts.
Bachelor, MBA or Master's degree in Statistics or related field with knowledge in the application of statistics using analytics software.
Database knowledge including table structures, views, queries, and SQL statements including window/analytic functions.
Competent with at least one analytics software package (Python, R, SAS, or SPSS) and comfortable working in Excel (can write advanced macros).
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker), and generating graphs and visuals that make an insight easy to understand.
Summarize data using the right statistical terms and explain those concepts to non-statistical audiences in plain language.
Familiar with core data engineering concepts — pipelines, schemas, ETL, and telemetry — enough to be a useful partner to engineering teams.
Clear documentation habits, and prioritization recommendations, give effort estimates, and flag scheduling conflicts early.
An interest in games: you play EA titles across platforms and follow industry and tech news.
Exposure to digital advertising metrics (impressions, reach and frequency, viewability) or game telemetry data.
Familiar with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$98,200 - $155,200 USD
Washington (depending on location e.g. Seattle vs. Spokane) *$93,800 - $122,000 USD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst Sr - Quality and Safety
Description:
Work Location: Downtown Seattle (Hybrid – 3 days/week on-site)

Supports the Hospital and Enterprise Analytics' vision, mission, and strategic initiatives by using technical expertise to design, create and develop analytical solutions and by providing internal consultation and project management. The incumbent provides leadership in the facilitating and gathering business requirements, and provides knowledge in business/clinical processes, analytical expertise, technical programming skills, and substantial leadership skills in working with key stakeholders, end users and project team members. This position identifies and resolves issues throughout the development of analytical solutions, and is accountable for identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow processes in the implementation of these solutions. Primary responsibility is the design, creation and deployment of analytical solutions for Executive leadership and other key stakeholders within the SCH organization. The incumbent is responsible for frequently taking a formal or an informal lead on project tasks, and leads efforts to design and implement analytic solutions, including reports, dashboards, and views from a wide range of existing data sources, and provides leadership in evaluating and optimizing these solutions. The incumbent also assures integrity of the data for current and future use in strategic initiatives, continuous quality improvement efforts and hospital goals, and for insuring the sustainability and adaptability of all developed solutions.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Health Science, Computer Science, Math, Business or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience/technical training that demonstrates analytical and technical competency.

Minimum five (5) years experience in progressively more responsible work as a data analyst, developer or equivalent.

Experience in data extraction/integration/aggregation using SQL, R or python.

Expert in use of data visualization for non-technical audiences.

Experience with at least one notable BI reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, Business Objects, html/d3).

Experience working with source control tools and version management.

Required Credentials

N/A.

Preferred

Experience working with senior and executive leaders.

Experience with EHR Data (Epic)

Quality and safety related experience.

Experience working as a data analyst within a healthcare setting.

Experience with clinical, hospital and/or financial applications and/or systems.

Experience as a member of a delivery team supporting integrated analytics products and solutions for a wide range of customer groups.

Uses reasonable and basic statistical analyses to make comparisons and detect trends, communicate insights.

Utilizes established data analysis models and tools for analyzing qualitative or quantitative data.

Compensation Range

$121,134.00 - $181,700.00 per year

Salary Information

This compensation range was calculated based on full-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

Disclaimer for Out of State Applicants

This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors.

Benefits Information

Seattle Children’s offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 403(b), life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more. Additional details on our benefits can be found on our website www.seattlechildrens.org/careers/benefits.

About Us

Hope. Care. Cure. These three simple words capture what we do at Seattle Children’s – to help every child live the healthiest and most fulfilling life possible. Are you ready to engage with a mission-driven organization that is life-changing to many, and touches the hearts of all? #HOPECARECURE

Our founding promise to the community is as valid today as it was over a century ago: we will care for all children in our region, regardless of the families’ ability to pay. Together, we deliver superior patient care, advance new discoveries and treatments through pediatric research, and serve as the pediatric and adolescent, academic medical center for Washington, Alaska, Montana and Idaho – the largest region of any children’s hospital in the country.

U.S. News & World Report consistently ranks Seattle Children’s among the nation’s best children’s hospitals. For more than a decade, Seattle Children’s has been nationally recognized in key specialty areas. We are honored to be one of the nation’s very best places to care for children and the top-ranked pediatric hospital in Washington and the Pacific Northwest.

As a Magnet designated institution, we recognize the importance of hiring and developing great talent to provide best-in-class care to the patients and families we serve. Our organizational DNA takes form in our core values: Compassion, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Equity and Innovation. Whether it’s delivering frontline care to our patients in a kind and caring manner, practicing the highest standards of quality and safety, or being relentlessly curious as we work towards eradicating childhood diseases, these values are the fabric of our culture and community. The future starts here.

Our Commitment

Seattle Children’s welcomes people of all experiences, backgrounds, and thoughts as this is what drives our spirit of inquiry and allows us to better connect with our patients and families. Our organization recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes based on merit without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The people who work at Seattle Children’s are members of a community that seeks to respect and celebrate all the qualities that make each of us unique. Each of us is empowered to be ourselves.

Seattle Children’s is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Workplace and Affirmative Action Employer.

Title: Senior People Analytics Data Analyst
Description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Human Resources People Analytics team. In this strategic role, you will leverage your analytical expertise and problem-solving skills to transform raw data into actionable insights, enabling HR and business leaders to optimize processes, enhance performance, and drive organizational efficiency. Your work will be pivotal in shaping data-driven HR strategies and fostering organizational success. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design advanced data models and visualizations that contribute to our mission of operational excellence.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key Responsibilities


Analyze HR data to deeply understand processes, trends, and opportunities, ensuring findings are actionable and aligned with organizational goals.
Design and implement advanced data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Tableau or PowerBI to drive strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with HR and business teams to identify to develop metrics that promote excellence and optimize workflows.
Perform detailed data analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability of insights provided to stakeholders.
Proactively address challenges, offering innovative, data-driven solutions that enhance HR processes and outcomes.
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively, ensuring all stakeholders understand implications and actions.
Develop and maintain data documentation, run books, and data dictionaries in collaboration with HR data governance.
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in people analytics and apply them to enhance our workforce strategies.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field or equivalent in years of exp.
8+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related domains.
Expertise in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI).
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide impactful solutions.
Excellent attention to detail, ensuring recommendations are accurate and actionable.
Strong communication skills for effective interaction with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A mindset of ownership and curiosity, with the drive to understand data within its broader business context.


Preferred Qualifications


Solid experience in HR analytics, with a deep understanding of its impact on talent management and policy decisions.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, Etc).
Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday and Cornerstone.
Familiarity with big data platforms and cloud technologies.


Special Mentions


Relocation assistance provided for qualified candidates.


Base Pay Range For

WA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Sr. Analyst partners closely with the Sr. Manager, Demand Generation Analytics & Performance and reports directly to the hiring manager, building and maintaining the always-on reporting, dashboards, and ad-hoc analysis that power the team's KPIs and diagnostic/leading indicators.

Always-On Reporting & Dashboarding


Dashboard Build & Maintenance: Design, build, and maintain Tableau dashboards and always-on reporting for demand gen KPIs, diagnostic metrics, and leading indicators.

Ad-Hoc Analysis: Perform ad-hoc, deep-dive analysis on demand gen performance questions as they come up, using SQL to independently query and join across data sources.

Cross-Functional Execution


Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with other analysts, data science, and data engineering teams to source data, resolve data quality issues, and align on reporting logic.
Technical Translation: Work with the Sr. Manager to turn metric and measurement designs into concrete queries, data models, and dashboard specs.

Experience & Technical Skills


3+ years of experience in Marketing/Demand Gen Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a highly quantitative field, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.

Comfortable performing ad-hoc analysis under time pressure and communicating findings clearly.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical/data findings to non-technical partners.
Effective collaborator who can work cross-functionally with analysts, data science, and data engineering teams to get work done.
Detail-oriented and reliable - comfortable owning always-on reporting that others depend on.


Preferred Qualifications


Working knowledge of additional analytical languages/tools such as Python, R, or dbt.

Experience partnering with data engineering or data science teams on data quality or pipeline issues.

Company Overview

Established in 1958, the Downtown Seattle Association (DSA) is a nonprofit membership organization whose mission is to create a healthy, vibrant downtown for all. By advocating on issues including transportation, economic development, and the urban experience, DSA works to ensure that downtown remains a great place to live, work, shop, and play. DSA also founded and manages the Metropolitan Improvement District, a business-improvement area spanning 285 square blocks downtown.

Position Overview

The Data Analyst position turns complex information into clear, useful insights that help DSA/MID understand downtown conditions, improve program operations, inform policy decisions, measure programmatic impact, and support DSA’s strategic plan. This role collects and analyzes a variety of economic, operational and public realm related data; develops dashboards, maps and recurring reports; assists in developing and implementing surveys to a variety of audiences, and communicates research findings to colleagues, DSA and MID leadership, MID ratepayers, DSA members, public partners and other key stakeholders.

Reporting to the Director of Research & Strategic Initiatives, the Data Analyst works across DSA/MID teams to establish reliable measures of success, improve data quality and make information accessible to a wide range of audiences. The ideal candidate is analytical, curious and detail-oriented, has a strong understanding of research methods, as well as sound judgment and a strong interest in helping make downtown Seattle a healthy, vibrant downtown for all.

Duties & Responsibilities


Build and/or maintain a variety of datasets related to downtown economic activity, pedestrian traffic, real estate and development trends, retail, tourism, transportation, public safety, public spaces, and MID operations.
Analyze data for trends, patterns and differences to assess downtown conditions and improve efficiency and outcomes of DSA and MID programs.
Support major research products, including the State of Downtown Economic Report, the monthly Downtown Dashboard, the Downtown Development Guide, MID service reporting and other publications or presentations.
Able to conduct as needed data and policy analysis to support strategic planning, economic development, advocacy, communications, marketing and operational decisions.
Ability to clearly communicate assumptions, limitations and methods, particularly when combining data from multiple sources.
Respond to data requests from colleagues, DSA members, MID ratepayers, board members, media and public partners in a timely, service-oriented manner.
Prepare charts, talking points and presentation materials, and present findings in meetings, as needed.
Coordinate with data vendors and public agencies to understand methodologies, resolve data issues and improve access to relevant information.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring data preparation, reporting and quality checks.
Improve the usability, reliability and accessibility of organizational data systems and reporting tools.
Develop templates, guidance and training that help staff use data consistently and confidently.
Stay current on relevant analytical methods, data sources and visualization practices.

Responsibilities

DSA is committed to internal and market equity. Salary is determined based on internal and market equity, internal and market data/salary ranges, and the applicant’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. 100% employer-paid**

ORCA transit card

Paid Holidays plus paid personal days

Remote workdays awarded each year

First Choice Employee Assistance Program

All applicants are carefully screened, and full consideration is given to their training, education, skills, aptitudes, experience, and previous work record. In addition, DSA does not discriminate based on genetic information in its employment related policies and practices, including coverage under its health benefits program.

Two to four years of professional experience in data analysis, public policy, research, program evaluation, urban planning, economics or a related field. Relevant education, internships and applied project experience may be considered
Strong Excel skills and working proficiency in SQL and database management
Superior demonstration of problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area

2+ years of program or project management experience
2+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data, track program health, and drive decisions

Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology

Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams
Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)

Compensation: $65,000 – $75,000 per year

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

The grid is going digital — smart meters, renewables, and AMI data have made utilities one of the most data-hungry industries in America. Get in early on an analytics niche with huge demand and surprisingly little competition.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Utilities & Energy to turn smart-meter, outage, asset, and customer data into insight. You will build reliability and load reporting, support demand forecasting and grid-modernization analytics, and deliver findings that improve operations and customer programs.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and analyze AMI/smart-meter, SCADA, outage, asset, and customer datasets using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for load, reliability metrics (SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI), and asset performance.
Support demand forecasting, load research, and energy-efficiency/demand-response program analytics.
Analyze outage and asset-health data to support predictive maintenance and grid-modernization initiatives.
Prepare data for regulatory reporting and rate-case filings to public utility commissions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting quality across platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to operations, planning, and regulatory stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in utilities, energy, or another asset-intensive industry.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with operational, sensor/meter, time-series, or customer data at scale.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL), Python (pandas, NumPy) including time-series analysis.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Utility data & systems: AMI/MDM platforms, SCADA/OT historians (OSIsoft PI exposure a plus), CIS/billing data.
Geospatial & cloud: Esri ArcGIS, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure or AWS data services.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of energy markets, demand response, load forecasting, or renewable-integration concepts.
Familiarity with reliability metrics (SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI) and regulatory reporting.
Exposure to predictive maintenance or asset-analytics use cases.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300, Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. Title: Data Analyst, In-Store
Description:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…


Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.
Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilities
Partner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.
Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.
Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis


We're Excited About You Because…


A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.
Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.
Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.

Title: Sr. Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. The team drives consumer adoption and expansion by analyzing market trends, optimizing acquisition strategies, and informing pricing and retention initiatives. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer growth.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
5+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
3+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
1+ years of experience leading projects


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 3: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.


SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Title: Principal Data Analyst (Principal Power Resource Planning Analyst)
Description:
Position Description

Tacoma Power Management is seeking a talented and driven individual to join its Resource Planning & Analytics team. As a Principal Power Resource Planning Analyst, you will help navigate Tacoma Power’s path into the future. This is a time of unprecedented change for electric utilities. New technologies, clean energy policies and changing markets are shifting the energy landscape and presenting new opportunities and challenges for utilities. Despite these changes, one thing remains constant: Tacoma Power will need to make sure it can keep the lights on and keep rates low for customers. Your work will be instrumental in ensuring that we can continue to provide customers with clean, low-cost and reliable power for years to come, regardless of what the future holds.

This position leads key modeling and analysis efforts that inform Tacoma Power’s long-term resource planning work, with particular focus area in demand-side resource economics, power market dynamics and customer demand modeling.

Please note: The Resource Planning & Analytics team currently has two positions open. This position is at the principal level, while the other is at the senior level (Senior Power Resource Planning Analyst). You must apply to each position individually to be considered for both.

In This Role, You Will


Model: Collaborate in the development, operation and refinement of the models we use to assess the benefits and costs of key long-term resource planning decisions under various scenarios of the future.
Analyze: Analyze and interpret data and modeling outputs and provide thoughtful explanation of results.
Advise: Participate in the development of resource planning recommendations and serve as subject matter expert within areas of expertise and provide technical guidance and support to team and staff in other groups.
Collaborate: Work closely with the Resource Planning & Analytics team to coordinate modeling assumptions and approaches and with other groups throughout the utility on specific projects.


Qualifications

Minimum Education*

Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, economics, statistics, mathematics or directly related field

Minimum Experience*

4 years of experience in statistical analysis, data modeling or data analytics including 1 year prior at senior, lead and/or supervisory level


Relevant education and experience may substitute for one another on a year-for-year basis


Licensing, Certifications And Other Requirements

Some positions may require individuals to complete annual training and pass a comprehensive personal risk assessment (background check) prior to employment and every five years thereafter as required by federal regulatory requirements (NERC-CIP)

Desired Qualifications


Strong investigative and exploratory skills
Experience with script-based data analysis tools (Python preferred)
Ability to present technical information clearly and concisely
Advanced degree in Economics, Finance, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering or related field
Previous experience successfully leading analysis projects
Knowledge of power system economics, wholesale energy markets and/or energy policy

Title: GTM Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Significant experience writing SQL queries to connect and clean large datasets, define KPIs, and provide leadership with accurate data to make informed decisions
Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive performance dashboards in Tableau or Power BI across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
2+ years of hands-on experience writing SQL to query and analyze large datasets (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)
1+ year of hands-on experience building dashboards and data visualizations in Tableau/PowerBI/Looker
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of Python (e.g., pandas) for data analysis, automation, or advanced analytics
Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Familiarity with Salesforce
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance

Paid sabbatical program after four years

Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement

Robust training programs on industry and soft skills

Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days

Company-wide events

Quarterly team building events

401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

This individual will collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional data teams to solve problems, implement new reporting solutions, and deliver successfully against high standards. A successful individual is a person that has a proven work ethic that drives the desired results. This is a hands-on position - the ideal candidate must be willing to “roll up the sleeves”.

This position will work with several stakeholders supporting the extended AWS Global Sales organization including Business Development, Marketing, Professional Services, Enterprise Support, Training and Certification and the Partner team. The individual must have the ability to communicate effectively across multiple technical and non-technical business units, as well as across other geographies. This role will focus on developing analytics around WW Mechanisms for Sales, Ops, and Leadership audiences.

Support data analytics activities to develop actionable insights on pipeline, usage, and revenue data

Develop new ways to define and measure programs effectiveness and organizational productivity

Define the key sales support systems/processes required to meet the rapid growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives

Develop relationships and processes with sales, support, partner, finance, HR, sales operations, and other stakeholders to identify and address reporting requirements and develop new business insights

Identify data issues, gaps in processes, and drive timely resolution

Support ad hoc analysis & participate on projects as needed

Be an expert in AI & analytics tools required to support the team

IDEAS — Insights, Data Engineering, Econometrics, Analytics & Science — is the organization within AWS SMGS Ops responsible for turning data into insight for the AWS Sales and Marketing business. We build with both native AWS technology — including state-of-the-art Generative AI — and industry-standard products, pairing the best of each to move faster, work smarter, and continually raise the bar on what our data and insights can do.

As Analytics & Insights Lead you will be a trusted member of this team — helping leaders drive performance and improve rhythm of business by supporting WW mechanisms through actionable insights. Get To Know The Pokémon Company International

The Pokémon Company International manages the Pokémon property outside of Asia and is responsible for brand management, licensing and marketing, the Pokémon Trading Card Game, the animated TV series, home entertainment, and the official Pokémon website. Pokémon was launched in Japan in 1996 and today is one of the most popular children’s entertainment properties in the world.

Learn more online at corporate.pokemon.com and pokemon.com.



Get to know the role


Job Title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance
Job Summary: This role will be responsible for deep analysis of complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers.
FLSA Classification (US Only): Exempt
People Manager: No


What you’ll do


Build and maintain automated data pipelines extracting financial data from Oracle Fusion Cloud (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets)
Transform raw data into clean, reporting-ready datasets; monitor pipelines and resolve data issues
Document data lineage and transformation logic
Design and maintain Tableau dashboards for key financial metrics
Translate Finance/Accounting requirements into technical specs, ensuring consistent metrics across tools
Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Tech teams on reporting needs and priorities
Provide ad hoc analysis for audits, forecasting, and management reporting; train users on self-service tools
Maintain validation checks reconciling source data to reports
Maintain data dictionaries and documentation
Drive automation and data quality improvements


What you’ll bring


Five (5) to seven (7) years of relevant professional experience or a demonstrated equivalent level of expertise
Bachelor's degree in an analytical field or a demonstrated equivalent level of applicable experience
Demonstrated proficient experience using SQL, Python or other coding languages and ETL tools (i.e. data build tool)
Experience using data visualization tools (i.e. Tableau, PowerBI)
Data warehouse architecture and modeling experience
Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle ADW strongly preferred
Familiarity with Databricks and other cloud-based data warehouses
Experience with implementing data quality monitoring and alerting systems
Experience with JIRA, Gitlab and Confluence
Business domain knowledge in accounting, finance, IP & royalty strongly preferred


Base Salary Range: For this role, new hires generally start between $95,000.00 - $127,000.00 per year. The full range is $95,000.00 - $172,000.00 per year. This range is applicable for the labor market where the role is intended to be hired. The final base salary is directly related to the candidate’s qualifications and professional experience uniquely.

How You’ll Be Successful


Passion for Pokémon: Develops an understanding of the Pokémon brand, the impact it has on our people, culture, business, fans, and communities, and applying that knowledge and passion to everything you do.
Challenging the Expected: Approaches challenges with curiosity and creativity, embracing the possibility of failure as an opportunity to learn something new, develop innovative ideas, solve complex problems and identify unique opportunities.
Integrity and Respect: Demonstrates integrity and respect by leading with empathy, listening to others, seeking out different perspectives, and taking personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and results.
Dedicated to Quality: Takes ownership to maintain and promote high standards, looks for new ways to learn and improve, and embraces a growth mindset to seek and apply feedback from others in an effort to continuously improve.
Building Relationships: Develops and strengthens relationships, adopting a “team first” mentality and working collaboratively to solve problems and meet shared goals.
Delighting Customers: Listens and understands the interests and needs of our customers and stakeholders, making them feel heard and important, and embracing these learnings to continue delivering a unique Pokémon experience.


What To Expect


An innovative culture driven by impact, delivering meaningful outcomes.
Company events that celebrate the spirit of Pokémon.
Competitive cash-based compensation programs.
100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you.
Generous paid family leave.
Employer-paid life insurance.
Employer-paid long and short-term income protection insurance.
US Employees: 401k Employer Matching.
UK/IRE/MX Employees: Pension Employer Contributions.
Fitness reimbursement.
Commuter benefit.
LinkedIn learning.
Comprehensive relocation package for certain roles.
Hybrid work environment.

Title: Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer retention.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
2+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
1+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00

Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.


SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Title: Program Data Analyst
Description:
Tesla Laboratories is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies.

Requirements

Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Program/Data Analyst to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area).

Perform program/data analysis tasks, including:


Data analytics related to tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Tracking financial metrics of success for construction and engineering-related projects
Budget tracking and execution metric presentation


In addition, the Program/Data Analyst will:


Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements
Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.)
Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes
Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing
Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues
Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies
Coordinate and facilitate meetings, make recommendations based on project requirements, coordinate workflow processes, schedule/coordinate Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and effectively communicate findings to project personnel; provide written minutes for all meetings
Review technical reports, RFIs, designs, design changes (design-build and design-bid-build), project deliverables, submittals, and cost proposals from contractors to ensure compliance with customer and RFP requirements
Provide technical support for review of the commissioning plan, design and construction submittals, and field inspections
Provide technical support for construction field activities
Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report
Provide weekly reports documenting technical engineering support and quality assurance on each assigned project, including status, issues, costs, schedule, and findings/observations/recommendations/data collected
Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences
Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management
Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations


Minimum of 5 years of financial management experience in a field related to the tasks described above.

Benefits

Tesla Laboratories offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and long-term success of our employees, including:

Competitive compensation

Health, dental, and vision insurance

Retirement plan with company contribution

Paid time off and federal holidays

Professional development and training opportunities

Supportive, family-focused company culture

Opportunities for long-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB

Position Summary

The Information Analyst III, Workforce Management is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that support workforce planning, operational performance, business decision-making, and regulatory compliance. This role partners closely with leaders and stakeholders across the organization to identify reporting needs, analyze trends, improve data quality, and develop scalable analytics solutions.

As a senior analyst, this position leads complex analytical initiatives, establishes reporting standards and best practices, mentors less experienced analysts, and drives data-informed decisions that support organizational goals. The Information Analyst III serves as a trusted advisor for workforce analytics and business intelligence needs across multiple functional areas.

This is a hybrid role, located on our campus in Mountlake Terrace WA

What You'll Do


Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex business challenges, define reporting requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions that improve operational performance, reduce costs, support compliance, and enhance workforce effectiveness.

Create and maintain technical documentation, reporting standards, data definitions, and process documentation.
Provide mentorship, guidance, and training to analysts and business partners on reporting tools, methodologies, and best practices.
Assist with project planning by estimating resource requirements, effort, timelines, and project complexity.
Develop workforce analytics, forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and operational performance reporting to support workforce management strategies.


What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; or four (4) years of equivalent work experience.
Five (5) years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that support business decision-making.


Preferred Qualifications


Three (3) or more years of experience in healthcare, health insurance, workforce management, or a related industry.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large-scale data environments.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern analytics environments.
Experience developing workforce analytics, staffing models, forecasting solutions, scheduling analytics, or operational performance reporting.
Knowledge of contact center operations, workforce planning, or healthcare operational analytics.

Advanced knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, and data analytics methodologies.
Strong understanding of relational databases, data structures, data governance, and reporting best practices.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical initiatives, manage competing priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to mentor analysts and promote best practices in reporting, analytics, and data management.

Ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical and reporting solutions that drive measurable results.
