TITLE: Decision Support Analyst

JOB OVERVIEW: The Decision Support Analyst supports organizational decision-making by collecting, validating, analyzing, and interpreting healthcare, finance, cost accounting, and operational data. This role partners with senior analysts, Finance, operational leaders, Information Technology to develop reports, conduct analyses, maintain data systems, develop pro-forma income statements, and support cost accounting methodologies that inform hospital operations, patient care, service line performance, and financial planning. The Analyst works with moderately complex datasets and contributes to routine and ad hoc reporting, cost model validation, overhead and indirect cost allocation, service line and procedure-level cost analysis, and documentation of decision support and cost accounting processes while continuing to build expertise in healthcare analytics and decision support systems.

DEPARTMENT: Treasury

HOURS OF WORK: Typically, Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm

REPORTS TO: Director Treasury Operations

Prerequisites:

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, healthcare administration, data analytics, or a related field required.

Minimum of five years of experience in healthcare analytics, financial analysis, decision support, cost accounting, or a related field required.

Experience working with healthcare, financial, operational, or cost accounting data, including reporting, analysis, and reconciliation activities required.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel required; experience with SQL, data query tools (Power BI ,Tableau ,Epic Reporting), reporting systems, or business intelligence applications preferred.

Understanding of financial concepts, cost accounting principles, cost structures, allocation methodologies, and data analysis techniques, including familiarity with healthcare operations, billing, clinical, budget, or general ledger systems.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organization, process documentation, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Understanding of cost accounting fundamentals, including direct and indirect costing, overhead allocation, allocation drivers, cost center structures, service line profitability, and chart of account relationships.

Ability to validate and reconcile data, apply basic statistical concepts, analyze trends, investigate variances, and explain differences between cost models, allocation outputs, and actual financial results.

Qualifications:

Working knowledge of healthcare financial, clinical, operational, billing, decision support, general ledger, budget, data warehouse, and cost accounting systems.

Ability to create pro-forma income statements and support service line, contribution margin, profitability, and financial performance analyses.

Ability to develop, maintain, validate, and document allocation methodologies, assumptions, cost drivers, process controls, and related cost accounting procedures.

Experience evaluating expense classifications, cost center mappings, and chart of account relationships preferred.

Strong organizational, teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to learn new systems, tools, and processes quickly.

See Generic Job Description for Administrative Partner.

Generic Job Functions: See Generic Job Description for Administrative Partner.

Collect, validate, reconcile, and analyze healthcare, finance, cost accounting, and operational data to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting sources.

Develop and maintain routine and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses that support operational, financial, cost accounting, service line, and decision support needs.

Prepare revenue, expense, utilization, profitability, contribution margin, service line, cost trend, and pro-forma analyses to support financial planning and performance review.

Support the development, maintenance, monthly processing, and validation of decision support models, cost models, reporting tools, data structures, cost accounting hierarchies, cost center mappings, and chart of account relationships.

Reconcile cost accounting system results and model outputs to the general ledger, financial statements, ancillary feeder systems, and other source systems; identify variances, root causes, corrections, and methodology refinements.

Develop, maintain, document, and periodically validate methodologies for assigning direct costs and allocating overhead, indirect costs, shared services, support departments, and other expenses across departments, service lines, procedures, programs, and reporting dimensions.

Review allocation statistics, cost drivers, source data, expense classifications, cost center assignments, and data mappings; recommend reclassifications or mapping changes to improve cost reporting and financial analytics.

Support department, service line, procedure-level, and patient-level cost models, including documentation of assumptions, data sources, allocation calculations, reconciliations, process controls, and methodology changes for management review or audit support.

Partner with Finance, operational leaders, senior analysts, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to understand reporting needs, validate data, automate processes, explain allocation results, and deliver actionable decision support solutions.

Support annual budget, forecasting, financial planning, service line analysis, process improvement, reporting standardization, automation initiatives, department projects, and other assigned initiatives.

TITLE: Decision Support Analyst

JOB OVERVIEW: The Decision Support Analyst supports organizational decision-making by collecting, validating, analyzing, and interpreting healthcare, finance, cost accounting, and operational data. This role partners with senior analysts, Finance, operational leaders, Information Technology to develop reports, conduct analyses, maintain data systems, develop pro-forma income statements, and support cost accounting methodologies that inform hospital operations, patient care, service line performance, and financial planning. The Analyst works with moderately complex datasets and contributes to routine and ad hoc reporting, cost model validation, overhead and indirect cost allocation, service line and procedure-level cost analysis, and documentation of decision support and cost accounting processes while continuing to build expertise in healthcare analytics and decision support systems.

DEPARTMENT: Treasury

HOURS OF WORK: Typically, Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm

REPORTS TO: Director Treasury Operations

Prerequisites:

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, healthcare administration, data analytics, or a related field required.

Minimum of five years of experience in healthcare analytics, financial analysis, decision support, cost accounting, or a related field required.

Experience working with healthcare, financial, operational, or cost accounting data, including reporting, analysis, and reconciliation activities required.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel required; experience with SQL, data query tools (Power BI ,Tableau ,Epic Reporting), reporting systems, or business intelligence applications preferred.

Understanding of financial concepts, cost accounting principles, cost structures, allocation methodologies, and data analysis techniques, including familiarity with healthcare operations, billing, clinical, budget, or general ledger systems.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organization, process documentation, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Understanding of cost accounting fundamentals, including direct and indirect costing, overhead allocation, allocation drivers, cost center structures, service line profitability, and chart of account relationships.

Ability to validate and reconcile data, apply basic statistical concepts, analyze trends, investigate variances, and explain differences between cost models, allocation outputs, and actual financial results.

Qualifications:

Working knowledge of healthcare financial, clinical, operational, billing, decision support, general ledger, budget, data warehouse, and cost accounting systems.

Ability to create pro-forma income statements and support service line, contribution margin, profitability, and financial performance analyses.

Ability to develop, maintain, validate, and document allocation methodologies, assumptions, cost drivers, process controls, and related cost accounting procedures.

Experience evaluating expense classifications, cost center mappings, and chart of account relationships preferred.

Strong organizational, teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to learn new systems, tools, and processes quickly.

Essential Responsibilities And Competencies:

Collect, validate, reconcile, and analyze healthcare, finance, cost accounting, and operational data to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting sources.

Develop and maintain routine and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses that support operational, financial, cost accounting, service line, and decision support needs.

Prepare revenue, expense, utilization, profitability, contribution margin, service line, cost trend, and pro-forma analyses to support financial planning and performance review.

Support the development, maintenance, monthly processing, and validation of decision support models, cost models, reporting tools, data structures, cost accounting hierarchies, cost center mappings, and chart of account relationships.

Reconcile cost accounting system results and model outputs to the general ledger, financial statements, ancillary feeder systems, and other source systems; identify variances, root causes, corrections, and methodology refinements.

Develop, maintain, document, and periodically validate methodologies for assigning direct costs and allocating overhead, indirect costs, shared services, support departments, and other expenses across departments, service lines, procedures, programs, and reporting dimensions.

Review allocation statistics, cost drivers, source data, expense classifications, cost center assignments, and data mappings; recommend reclassifications or mapping changes to improve cost reporting and financial analytics.

Support department, service line, procedure-level, and patient-level cost models, including documentation of assumptions, data sources, allocation calculations, reconciliations, process controls, and methodology changes for management review or audit support.

Partner with Finance, operational leaders, senior analysts, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to understand reporting needs, validate data, automate processes, explain allocation results, and deliver actionable decision support solutions.

Support annual budget, forecasting, financial planning, service line analysis, process improvement, reporting standardization, automation initiatives, department projects, and other assigned initiatives.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack (Strategic Revenue Insights)
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Revenue Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About The Role

We’re looking for intelligent, driven professionals to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team is responsible for comprehensive analyses, reporting, and data solutions to support and grow our Revenue segments.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem solving skills, the ability to craft comprehensive narratives for both internal and external stakeholders, and produce tools and solutions to scale data usage with Revenue. In addition to analytical rigor, the ideal candidate has strong interpersonal skills to work proactively within the organization and with clients to drive forward recommendations.

What You’ll Do

Optimize decisions and execution with analyses, and communicate to internal and external partners


Be a strategic partner with our Client Success and Marketplace Teams as the data SME for respective Revenue segments and merchants for their point-of-sale and Marketplace business
Create business cases, insights, and dashboards as well as handle experiments to engage Affirm’s external merchant base; demonstrating Affirm’s value proposition and product performance
Create internal analyses to assess Revenue performance, drive recommendations, and inform critical decisions; using insights to serve segment strategy and execution


Scale impact


Standardize common use cases, provide the analytics infrastructure, and automate analyses and dashboards to scale decisions and execution within Revenue and with top external merchants


Own comprehensive analytics solution


Define KPIs, performance benchmarks, and methodologies, including identifying and working with unstructured and structured data sources (in-house and third-party) to enable solutions and generate actionable insights
Provide project and analytics guidance to a cross-functional team, acting as the analytics point of contact
Propose, monitor, and contextualize experiment design and execution to drive optimizations of Affirm’s GTM efforts, empirically quantify the value of Affirm to our prospective merchants, and upsell enhanced offers to existing merchants


What We Look For


5+ years of experience in an analytically-driven role (consulting, finance, analytics, etc.)
Strong working knowledge of SQL, data visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Looker, Tableau). Understanding or a demonstrated aptitude to learn Python is a plus
Demonstrated aptitude in leveraging AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
Exceptional problem-solving skills, including ability to operate in ambiguity and establishing analytical frameworks to apply to business problems
Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations, such as aligning stakeholders, or choosing the most impactful data to drive decisions
Ability to communicate effectively, and craft compelling narratives to influence business and technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization, internally and externally
Strong organization and execution skills, including ability to operate independently and drive multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously to drive business goals
Prior track record in building successful cross-functional relationships with partners internally and externally
Self-starter and a track record of successfully driving projects from end to end (from building strategy to implementation)
Passion and drive to disrupt both the retail and lending industry for the better
Enough laziness to find a faster way to do your least favorite tasks
Humility and a team player - you go out of your way to help teammates


Nice to Have


Knowledge of the FinTech or Payments industry
Prior experience performing data analytics for marketplace platforms
Demonstrated aptitude in AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)


Pay Grade - M

Equity Grade - 8

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $185,000 - $245,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $164,000 - $224,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Supply Chain Analyst II
Description:
About Leviton

At Leviton, we build what's next to light, power, and connect everyday spaces, from electrical to lighting, to data networks, and energy management. With over 115 years of history, Leviton develops thoughtful solutions that help make its customers' lives easier, safer, more efficient, and more productive. We recognize that our people are our greatest asset. We ASK questions, EMBRACE challenges, SEEK new perspectives, and ANTICIPATE what comes next. It's about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly changing world.

About The Role

The Supply Chain Analyst II is responsible for independently applying analytical, reporting, and continuous-improvement methods to improve Supply Chain and Manufacturing performance. This position works cross functionally with multiple departments (i.e. Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering, etc.) developing and maintaining business intelligence solutions, dashboards, and key performance indicators supporting Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Inventory, Delivery, Cost, Efficiency, and Lean Manufacturing objectives.

Responsibilities


Independently perform data mining, data modeling, statistical analysis, cost-benefit analysis, root-cause analysis, and scenario modeling to support supply chain and manufacturing decisions.
Develop and maintain supply chain and manufacturing data models, reporting structures, and analytical tools using Excel, SQL Server, Microsoft Integration Services, Power BI, and other approved data-management technologies.
Analyze performance across production, inventory, planning, procurement, capacity, cost, delivery, service, and quality to identify trends, risks, constraints, and improvement opportunities.
Develop, maintain, and enhance supply chain and manufacturing key performance indicators, management dashboards, scorecards, and exception-reporting tools.
Evaluate factory performance, shortages, performance to plan, supplier performance, quality performance, warehouse performance, and other drivers as assigned.
Develop recommendations and business cases based on analytical findings, including expected operational benefits, financial impact, implementation requirements, and potential risks.
Present analytical findings, conclusions, and recommendations to supply chain and manufacturing management.
Lead defined analytical, reporting, and process-improvement workstreams from problem definition through implementation and measurement of results.
Partner with Planning, Procurement, Operations, Manufacturing, Finance, Information Technology, and other business functions to address key problem areas and implement approved solutions.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports, data preparation, workflows, and manual analytical processes.
Establish appropriate data-validation and quality-control methods to improve the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of supply chain information.
Provide analytical support for supply chain and manufacturing projects, continuous-improvement initiatives, and management priorities.


Qualifications

Technical


Demonstrated experience independently analyzing business problems and translating results into practical recommendations required
Experience in creating and maintaining dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and management reporting required.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data modeling, advanced formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and analytical reporting.
Proficiency in Power BI, including data preparation, data modeling, dashboard development, visualization, and report maintenance.
Proficiency with SQL, including queries, joins, aggregations, data validation, and the interpretation of relational datasets.
Ability to conduct root-cause analysis, scenario analysis, cost-benefit analysis, and quantitative business analysis.
Ability to convert complex data into clear findings, business implications, and actionable recommendations.
Experience working in a LEAN manufacturing or technology-manufacturing environment is preferred.


Behavioral


Communication - Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with coworkers, along with internal and external customers and key stakeholders
Problem-Solver - Strong problem-solving skills to identify issues and develop effective solutions
Attention to Detail - Ensure accuracy in work product, documentation, and processes to maintain high standards
Analytical Skills - Analyze data to make informed decisions
Critical Thinking - Ability to think critically and make informed decisions to optimize performance
Research Skills - Ability to conduct thorough research to create well-informed and credible content and decisions


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree required (preferably in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations Management)
Professional certifications such as ASCM CPIM, CSCP, CLTD, Lean Six Sigma, Microsoft Power BI, or similar credentials are preferred.
Minimum three years of progressively responsible experience in supply chain, manufacturing, or business analytics


What We Offer

Comprehensive benefits include:


Medical (with an HSA option), Dental, Vision and Rx coverage beginning the 1st day of the month following your start date
401(k) Program with employer matching contributions. Participation begins immediately upon hire; employer match begins after 1 year of service
Life, Disability, Accident and Critical Illness insurance options
Up to 11 paid Holidays
Up to 18 days Paid Time Off


Other perks include Volunteer Time Off, Tuition Reimbursement, Health Advocacy Program, Bereavement Leave, and additional wellness incentive programs.

For more information about benefits, please go to: https://careers.leviton.com/benefits

The Supply Chain Analyst II is responsible for independently applying analytical, reporting, and continuous-improvement methods to improve Supply Chain and Manufacturing performance. This position works cross functionally with multiple departments (i.e. Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering, etc.) developing and maintaining business intelligence solutions, dashboards, and key performance indicators supporting Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Inventory, Delivery, Cost, Efficiency, and Lean Manufacturing objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Independently perform data mining, data modeling, statistical analysis, cost-benefit analysis, root-cause analysis, and scenario modeling to support supply chain and manufacturing decisions.

  • Analyze performance across production, inventory, planning, procurement, capacity, cost, delivery, service, and quality to identify trends, risks, constraints, and improvement opportunities.

  • Proficiency in Power BI, including data preparation, data modeling, dashboard development, visualization, and report maintenance.
  • Proficiency with SQL, including queries, joins, aggregations, data validation, and the interpretation of relational datasets.
  • Ability to conduct root-cause analysis, scenario analysis, cost-benefit analysis, and quantitative business analysis.

  • Critical Thinking - Ability to think critically and make informed decisions to optimize performance

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (onsite in Bothell, WA)
Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.
Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership with a clear narrative arc — leading with the takeaway, tailoring the message to the audience, and using clean visuals to drive confident, data-informed decisions.
Document processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures using Oracle Agile and Microsoft Loop to enable knowledge transfer and team continuity.
Manage multiple concurrent requests; pull work proactively from the team backlog and move projects forward without needing step-by-step direction.
Build stakeholder review cycles into project timelines — share drafts with enough lead time to incorporate feedback rather than pushing deliverables out at the last minute.


Knowledge And Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud reporting (leads, opportunities, quotes).
Experience with Oracle Eloqua (or equivalent) for email marketing reporting and campaign analytics.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for web and on-page analytics.
Working knowledge of Oracle EBS as a business system (modules, workflows, terminology).
Demonstrated experience automating manual reporting or processes.
Experience with Google BigQuery, particularly for interfacing with GA4 data exports.
Familiarity with Qualtrics for survey design and analysis.


Skills/Abilities


Proficiency with Tableau (Desktop and Server) building dashboards, publishing, working with extracts and permissions.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, basic modeling).
Basic SQL knowledge — comfortable reading queries and writing simple SELECT/JOIN statements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to executives, including C-suite leadership.
Strong time and project management skills — including proactive planning for stakeholder review and feedback cycles.
Self-starter mindset: comfortable pulling work from a backlog, clarifying scope with the manager and stakeholders, and driving tasks to completion independently.
Strong documentation skills and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
Exposure to data governance & data architecture concepts.
Familiarity with ETL or data prep tools (Tableau Prep, Alteryx, Python/Pandas, dbt).
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance analyst workflows — drafting, summarizing, accelerating analysis, or generating code.


Salary And Benefits


$75,000.00/yr - $95,000.00/yr depending on experience (Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).
Insurance:
Medical, Dental & Vision
Life & Company paid Disability
Retirement Plan (401k):
4% automatic Company contribution
Fujifilm matches 50 cents for every dollar you contribute, up to 6% of your salary
Paid Time Off:
You can accrue up to 120 hours of PTO in your first year of employment
PTO increases based on years of service
Employee Choice Holidays:
32 hours additional paid time off, based on date of hire in the calendar year
Paid Holidays:
Eight (8) paid holidays per year

Title: Operations and Supply Chain Analyst
Description:
Be Part of Our Story




Verathon is a global medical device company committed to being a trusted partner to our customers and advancing patient care through innovative Airway Management and Urology solutions. For more than 40 years, we have worked alongside healthcare professionals to understand their needs and deliver high-quality technologies that provide lasting clinical and economic value.




Our portfolio includes leading GlideScope® video laryngoscopy and BFlex™ bronchoscopy solutions, BladderScan® bladder volume measurement, and a growing range of single-use Urology solutions. Behind our innovations is a diverse, global team united by a commitment to our customers, collaboration, and improving patient care.




Verathon, a business unit of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, with international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe, and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.




The Senior Operations & Supply Chain Analyst serves as the primary analytics and business intelligence resource for the Operations organization. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining executive dashboards, managing Operations KPIs, performing advanced data analysis, automating business processes, and delivering actionable insights that improve operational performance across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Planning, and Logistics.




How will you add Value?




The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with technical expertise to transform operational data into meaningful business intelligence using Microsoft technologies and AI-enabled tools.




Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards, and operational reporting for the Operations organization.
Serve as the owner of the Operations KPI framework, including KPI definitions, calculations, governance, reporting standards, and data integrity.
Monitor, analyze, and report operational performance against established metrics, providing actionable recommendations to leadership.
Perform advanced analytics across inventory, procurement, planning, manufacturing, logistics, supplier performance, quality, and customer fulfillment.
Conduct root cause analysis and present recommendations that improve operational performance and support strategic decision making.
Design, develop, and maintain SQL queries, relational databases, and data models that support reporting and analytics.
Develop scalable datasets and reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth for Operations.
Partner with Operations, Finance, Quality, Engineering, and IT to identify reporting requirements and deliver business intelligence solutions.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, workflows, and business processes using Microsoft Power Platform technologies, including Power Automate and Power Apps.
Leverage AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and other approved AI tools, to improve analytics, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.
Maintain reporting documentation, KPI definitions, data dictionaries, and reporting standards.
Support ERP reporting and data analysis initiatives while ensuring data accuracy and integrity across multiple business systems.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through automation, standardization, and data-driven decision making.
Stay current on emerging Microsoft technologies, Power Platform capabilities, and AI innovations.




Who are we looking for?




Bachelor's Degree (BA or BS) in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Management, Computer Science, or related field required.
5+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Operations Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related analytical roles within a manufacturing environment; medical device experience preferred.
Advanced experience developing Power BI dashboards using DAX, Power Query, and data modeling best practices.
Strong SQL development skills, including writing complex queries and developing relational databases.
Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or similar Microsoft data platforms preferred.
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps, preferred.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, PivotTables, and advanced analytical functions.
Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, Epicor, or similar manufacturing ERP systems.
Experience using generative AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar technologies to improve analytics, reporting, documentation, and business process automation preferred.
Strong understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, inventory management, procurement, planning, and logistics processes.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and project management skills.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement principles preferred.
APICS CPIM or CSCP certification preferred.
Proficient user of Microsoft 365 applications.




The Benefits of Working with Us




Salary Range. $100,000-$134,000 (Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).
Additional Earning Potential. Full-time employees who are not on a commission plan are eligible for Verathon’s annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance.
Wellness & Life Balance Programs. Competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, auto allowance and a 401(k) matching plan. For more information, please visit our complete Benefits Summary https://www.verathon.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/US_HQ_Employee_Benefits_Summary.pdf.
Growth & Development. Professional development programs, internal promotions, certification courses, and tuition reimbursement.
Fun & Employee Engagement. Team appreciation events, team building activities and celebrations with a culture centered on employee engagement.




Our 7 Core Values




By living the values, our amazing team members are empowered to be all they can be, both professionally and personally. We are proud of the values and the people who together make up our culture. It is what makes Verathon such a special place to work.

Our Customers are at the Center of Everything We Do
Winning Together
Continuous Improvement Creates Competitive Advantage
Be Better Be Different
Do the Right Thing; Do Things Right
We Are Genuine
Enjoy the Journey

About The Job

The Google.org Tech for Social Impact (TSI) team helps nonprofits and civic entities achieve sustained social impact at scale by providing data infrastructure, visualization tools, and technology. Our team serves as the central hub for Google.org’s data, unifying global giving information into a source of truth to help leadership track and maximize the organization’s philanthropic impact.

Working closely with pillar leads and operations teams, you will translate strategic outlook into tangible changes in funding models, budget allocation, and operational capabilities. Through regular engagement with Google.org executives, you will build consensus around high-stakes decisions and mobilize cross-functional teams to execute on key initiatives.

About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

In this role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the Google Ads ecosystem. Your role is a blend of technical data analysis, strategic cross-functional leadership, and direct investigative work. You will use data to predict their next moves, influence how engineering teams build detection systems, and ensure that safety measures do not disrupt the experience for legitimate advertisers.

We are on a critical mission to protect Google's users and ensure online safety across core and emerging Ads products. Our team is at the forefront of raising the bar on content through coherent policies and scaled, effective enforcement. We have expanded beyond traditional product protections to manage emerging challenges—including brand safety and controversial content across Google's growing Ads ecosystem.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $116000 - $166000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Collaborate with cross-functional groups such as Product Manager (PM), Engineering, Sales and Legal to drive projects that increases users' safety and provide better online experience through Google Ads.

Conduct investigations to catch fraudsters, enforce our product policies, learn scam patterns/trends and identify product vulnerabilities.

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Intelligence
Description:
The Sr Analyst, Workforce Intelligence serves as the analytics and insights partner to Fortive Talent Partners and OpCo HR teams. The role transforms employee listening, workforce, talent, organization, and work data into actionable insights and recommendations, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled approaches to improve the speed, scale, and quality of insight generation, enabling, better talent, workforce, and organizational decisions.

The role is responsible for Fortive's employee listening strategy and workforce intelligence capability, including the processes, methodologies, reporting, and resources that support enterprise and OpCo decision-making. Through analysis of workforce trends, employee sentiment, organizational effectiveness, skills, automation, and future workforce needs, the role helps Talent Partners, HRBPs, and leaders identify risks, evaluate options, and prioritize actions.

OPERATING MODEL

1 EMPLOYEE LISTENING & EXPERIENCE INSIGHT

2 PEOPLE & ORGANIZATION INTELLIGENCE

3 GOVERNANCE, PRODUCTS & ENABLEMENT

Own the listening strategy and convert employee feedback into potential action.

Connect people, work, organization, and technology data to illuminate decisions.

Create scalable standards, resources, and clear enterprise service commitments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

WORKFORCE INTELLIGENCE & OPERATING MODEL


Establish and continuously improve Fortive's Workforce Intelligence operating model, including services, governance, delivery standards, and stakeholder expectations.
Define and deliver a clear portfolio of workforce intelligence products, insights, resources, and support for Talent Partners and HRBPs.
Develop scalable methodologies, tools, and self-service resources that strengthen data-driven decision making across Fortive, including AI-enabled intelligence products and analytical approaches that improve insight generation, pattern detection, forecasting.
Partner with HR Technology, HR Operations, and data owners to improve data quality, usability, and reporting effectiveness.


EMPLOYEE LISTENING & ORGANIZATIONAL INSIGHT


Own Fortive's employee listening strategy, including listening priorities, survey and pulse programs, governance, reporting, and insight generation.
Partner with VP, Talent Planning & Capability as well as Talent Partners to identify critical workforce questions and translate business needs into focused listening and analytical plans.
Analyze employee sentiment, engagement, retention, organizational health, and workforce trends to identify opportunities, risks, and root causes.
Translate complex findings into practical recommendations that enable Talent Partners and HRBPs to take targeted action with business leaders.


WORKFORCE & ORGANIZATION ANALYTICS


Generate enterprise and OpCo insights across workforce, talent, skills, succession, mobility, performance, and employee experience data.
Provide Talent Partners and HRBPs with data-driven recommendations that inform talent reviews, workforce planning, succession discussions, organizational effectiveness, and capability decisions.
Apply AI-enabled and advanced analytical techniques to synthesize structured and unstructured workforce data, identify emerging patterns and risks, develop scenarios, and generate decision-relevant insights.
Analyze organization and work patterns to inform organization design, workforce productivity, automation, AI adoption, and capability planning.
Integrate multiple data sources into dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses that enable better talent, workforce, and business decisions.


SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS

OWNS

INFLUENCES

DOES NOT OWN


Enterprise employee listening strategy
Workforce Intelligence methods, standards, resources, and service commitments
Analytical quality, interpretation, validation, and responsible use of AI-enabled workforce intelligence methods
Employee experience and organizational effectiveness priorities
Workforce, organization design, automation, and capability choices
Talent, workforce planning, and action priorities
Data and technology requirements
Employee listening platforms or HR technology
OpCo talent, workforce, or organization strategy
Business staffing, organization design, or automation decisions
Enterprise HR data governance outside the role's scope
Leaders’ accountability for workforce and employee outcomes


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in industrial-organizational psychology, organizational research, analytics, data science, economics, human resources, or a related discipline preferred.
8+ years of experience in data analytics with a preference for people or workforce analytics, employee listening, organizational research, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, consulting, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience managing employee listening or survey programs preferred, as well as translating quantitative and qualitative findings into practical action.
Strong analytical capability, including statistical analysis, trend identification, data visualization, and integration of multiple forms of evidence.
Demonstrated ability to apply AI-enabled analytical tools and methods to workforce or business questions, combined with the judgment to validate outputs, recognize limitations, protect sensitive information, and ensure responsible human oversight.
Experience developing executive-level dashboards, reports, and decision-support materials that make complex topics clear and actionable.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, project management, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility with senior leaders and diverse HR partners.
Experience operating effectively in a global, matrixed environment and handling sensitive workforce and employee information with sound judgment and discretion.

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS OPERATIONS ANALYST (STARLINK AVIATION)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, will deliver low-latency broadband internet worldwide. As an Business Operations Analyst within the Starlink program, you will develop advanced insights and actionable data to advise internal business leaders on critical trends and operational needs for the company’s enterprise and government teams. You will create high-impact, efficient, and economical solutions by transforming complex internal data into clear, strategic recommendations.

We are looking for strategic thinkers with a passion for data-driven decision-making. You will lead internal initiatives to analyze operational performance, identify emerging trends, and build powerful narratives that guide leadership on resource allocation, process optimization, and long-term planning. You will create and maintain sophisticated dashboards and analytical tools to monitor key internal metrics across commercial, engineering, production, test, inventory, quality, and supply chain functions. Ideal team members are highly analytical professionals from strategy consulting or investment banking backgrounds who excel in flexible environments, are extremely proficient with Excel, data analysis, dashboards, and PowerPoint, and bring credibility, clarity, and smart decision-making to our internal stakeholders and leadership teams.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain advanced data analysis tools, interactive dashboards, and tracking systems to analyze operational performance, historical trends, and emerging patterns across Starlink Aviation internal processes and functions

Anticipate and identify operational challenges and opportunities through rigorous data analysis, determine root causes, and develop data-backed solutions for immediate mitigation as well as long-term strategic improvement and prevention

Take complex internal data sets and build insightful, powerful narratives using Excel, dashboards, and PowerPoint to communicate findings, trends, and recommendations to internal business leaders and stakeholders

Partner with cross-departmental internal teams (including commercial, finance, industrial design, engineering, application software, production, test, inventory, quality, and supply chain) to gather data, synchronize efforts, and create tight internal feedback loops for continuous operational improvement

Partner with all levels of leadership within the organization to develop and review potential projects, steer allocation of improvement resources, and ensure sustainability of implemented solutions based on data-driven insights

Manage analytical projects and execute to tight timelines while effectively communicating to and influencing internal stakeholders

Codify knowledge and best practices of internal systems and processes, actively ensuring these documents and practices are updated and maintained

Drive positive business outcomes across disciplines including commercial, engineering, production, test, inventory, quality, and supply chain by delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making

Title: Government Healthcare Data Consultant
Description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Government Human Service Consultant (GHSC) - Informatics team at Mercer, a Marsh business. This role can be based in Phoenix, Minneapolis, Atlanta, or Seattle and offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Medicaid is a government-sponsored health insurance program in the United States designed to provide healthcare coverage to low-income individuals and families. As a consulting firm specializing in Medicaid, Mercer’s GHSC team assists state governments in optimizing their Medicaid programs. Our team plays a vital role in managing and analyzing Medicaid claims data to enhance patient access to care, improve cost efficiency, and elevate the quality of services provided to these individuals.

As a Government Healthcare Data Consultant, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced programmers, actuaries, and clinicians, contributing to meaningful projects that aim to positively impact the lives of individuals and families in need. Join us in making a difference!

We will count on you to:


Utilize SAS programming software to interpret, validate and analyze large health care data sets
Participate in initial meetings with clients or project leads to define the scope of the project and provide insight and expertise including knowledge of the capabilities and flexibility of various approaches
Define the data process based on project scope, insight from the project lead and direction from the project's senior actuarial staff
Understand the reasons and impacts of data anomalies and exceptions on the analysis, formulate solutions, and communicate to client teams
Thrive and be motivated by an environment that embraces AI and technology-enabled tools
Perform technical peer review for data analysis projects
Act as a mentor for junior staff


What you need to have:


BA/BS or equivalent experience required
Minimum 4 years’ experience using SAS (desired), SQL, or equivalent programming language
Experience with healthcare claims data
Strong analytical and mathematical skills
Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a demanding work environment
Strong critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills


What makes you stand out?


Experience with Medicaid programs and associated health care data, preferably in a consulting environment
Excellent interpersonal skills; strong oral and written communication skills


Why join our team:


We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact on colleagues, clients, and communities.
Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.


The applicable base salary range for this role is $68,500 to $137,000.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, 401K savings and other retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.

Title: Clinical Data Analyst, Spotfire
Description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Bothell, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

The Spotfire Clinical Data Analyst will specialize in the installation, maintenance, and development of clinical data visualizations utilizing Spotfire. This role emphasizes creating and enhancing Spotfire-based patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and other customized visualization reports such as live TLFs. Additionally, the Analyst will collaborate closely with Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Science, and Clinical Operations to optimize data visualization strategies.

This position requires a full-time onsite presence at our Bothell, WA office or Princeton, NJ office.

Responsibilities:


Lead the installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of Spotfire for clinical data analysis and visualization
Design, develop, and maintain Spotfire dashboards for patient profiles, real-time clinical data review, surveillance, metrics tracking, and other customized visualizations
Develop sophisticated, interactive visualizations to support internal data review processes, surveillance, reconciliation, and reporting needs
Collaborate with Clinical Data Managers, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Clinical Science teams to identify requirements and translate them into effective Spotfire visualizations
Manage and continually improve the Spotfire analytics environment, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance
Establish and maintain a Global Spotfire Library, aligning visualization standards across multiple studies and programs
Train and mentor Clinical Data Managers and other stakeholders in effectively utilizing Spotfire dashboards and reports
Coordinate timelines and deliverables with Clinical Data Management and other cross-functional teams to ensure visualizations meet expectations
Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of new technologies and methodologies to enhance Spotfire capabilities
Document visualization specifications, maintain clear documentation for Spotfire-related processes, and contribute to departmental SOPs
Uphold industry standards including protocol compliance, ICH GCP, FDA regulations, and CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM)


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Biostatistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Spotfire visualization development and administration in a clinical trial setting, preferably in oncology and hematology
Expert-level proficiency in Spotfire including installation, configuration, dashboard development, data integration, scripting (IronPython, TERR, etc.) and performance optimization
Strong experience developing patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and complex reports
Experience with SAS/R, SQL programming, and data manipulation
Familiarity with clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM, ADaM), experience with TLF generation preferred
Experience integrating Spotfire with clinical databases and EDC systems (e.g., Medidata RAVE, Oracle Inform, Veeva)
Strong organizational skills, critical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Familiarity with regulatory guidelines including GCP, ICH, and FDA requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)


Compensation and Benefits:

The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $130,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and skills.

SystImmune is a leading and well-funded biotech company with a bright future. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success.

Title: Senior Government Healthcare Data Consultant
Description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Government Healthcare Consulting - Informatics team at Marsh. This role can be based in Phoenix, Minneapolis, Atlanta, or Seattle and offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Medicaid is a government-sponsored health insurance program in the United States designed to provide healthcare coverage to low-income individuals and families. As a consulting firm specializing in Medicaid, Marsh’s Government Healthcare Consulting team assists state governments in optimizing their Medicaid programs. Our team plays a vital role in managing and analyzing Medicaid claims data to enhance patient access to care, improve cost efficiency, and elevate the quality of services provided to these individuals.

As a Sr.Government Healthcare Data Consultant, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced programmers, actuaries, and clinicians, contributing to meaningful projects that aim to positively impact the lives of individuals and families in need. Join us in making a difference!

We will count on you to:


Utilize SAS programming software to interpret, validate and analyze large health care data sets
Participate in initial meetings with clients or project leads to define the scope of the project and provide insight and expertise including knowledge of the capabilities and flexibility of various approaches
Define the data process based on project scope, insight from the project lead and direction from the project's senior actuarial staff
Understand the reasons and impacts of data anomalies and exceptions on the analysis, formulate solutions, and communicate to client teams
Thrive and be motivated by an environment that embraces AI and technology-enabled tools
Perform technical peer review for data analysis projects
Act as a mentor for junior staff


What you need to have:


BA/BS or equivalent experience required
Minimum 5 years’ experience using SAS (desired), SQL, or equivalent programming language
Experience with healthcare claims data
Strong analytical and mathematical skills
Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a demanding work environment
Strong critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills


What makes you stand out?


Experience with Medicaid programs and associated health care data, preferably in a consulting environment
Excellent interpersonal skills; strong oral and written communication skills


Why join our team:


We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact on colleagues, clients, and communities.
Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Job Description:

Every day, Russell Investments seeks to improve financial security for people. We put clients at the center of everything we do, combining deep investment expertise with innovative technology and data-driven insights to help them achieve better outcomes. Joining the Global Performance & Reporting team within Global Risk, you'll help modernize the investment analytics platform that supports Russell Investments' global products, clients, and investment professionals. We're transforming how investment performance is measured, analyzed, and delivered through scalable technology, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.

The Performance Analyst supports the calculation, analysis, and communication of investment performance across a range of products while working with Investment Data, Risk, Technology, Product, Client Service, Portfolio Management, and Engineering to deliver accurate analytics and reporting. This role provides an opportunity to develop strong investment performance and technical skills while contributing to process improvements, automation, data quality, and the modernization of Russell Investments' global performance and reporting capabilities.

Your Core Responsibilities:

Investment Performance & Analytics


Build knowledge of investment performance measurement, attribution methodologies, benchmark construction, GIPS standards, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Prepare accurate and timely performance analytics and reporting for clients, funds, regulators, GIPS composites, and internal stakeholders, with guidance as needed.
Support research into performance methodologies and contribute to improvements in analytics and reporting quality.
Investigate performance questions, identify discrepancies, and escalate complex issues while supporting the development of practical solutions.


Automation & Technology


Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of Python-based applications and automation solutions that simplify business processes and reduce manual work.
Contribute to automated reporting pipelines, reconciliation tools, monitoring solutions, reusable Python libraries, and internal applications that improve operational efficiency.
Write and maintain SQL queries that support investment analytics, reporting, data validation, and automation initiatives.
Assist with integrating enterprise data sources and external platforms through APIs and data exchange technologies including REST, JSON, and XML.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to support solution delivery and team productivity.


Business Partnership & Reporting


Support performance and reporting readiness activities for new client launches and portfolio onboarding.
Collaborate with Investment Data, Risk, Technology, Product, Client Service, Marketing, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to support reporting and analytical solutions.
Support enhancements to reporting platforms including Vermilion, Morningstar, SS&C, and related reporting ecosystems.
Contribute to the standardization of reporting processes and deliverables to improve consistency and reduce operational risk.
Document business processes, methodologies, technical designs, and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and governance.


Innovation & Continuous Improvement


Identify and communicate opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve performance measurement and reporting processes.
Develop knowledge of investment performance, attribution, financial markets, data management, software engineering, and AI technologies.
Support team initiatives related to reporting modernization, return analytics, automation, and internal application development.
Participate in continuous improvement efforts and suggest practical ways to improve team processes and outcomes.


Your Expertise:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent coursework in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
Relevant experience, internship, or academic project work in investment performance, investment reporting, financial technology, investment analytics, or a related analytical discipline preferred.
Foundational experience with Python and an interest in developing automation solutions and internal applications.
Working knowledge of SQL, including joins and basic data manipulation; exposure to CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, or data modeling is helpful.
Exposure to APIs, relational databases, JSON/XML, version control, or modern software development practices preferred.
Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with others.
Ability to apply analytical thinking and technology to understand problems and support solutions.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain strong attention to detail.

Coursework, internship, or experience related to investment performance measurement, attribution, GIPS, or investment reporting.
Exposure to Vermilion, Morningstar Direct, SS&C, Bloomberg, Power BI, or similar investment platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies.

Title: Senior Sales Analytics Analyst
Description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Overview:

As the largest food & beverage company in the world, we sell over a billion products every day. Nestle’s sales team is the driving force behind every unit sold, focused on building strong categories by delighting our consumers while representing Nestle’s iconic brands with our retail partners.

The Sales Analytics team is the analytical intelligence engine that powers our Divisional sales & headquarter teams. The insights, data, and analytical expertise that our Sr Sales Analysts provide shape our strategic business decisions and equip our sales team to meet our consumer needs and drive category growth. The Sr. Analyst supports the division sales & CDCE team by leading strategic analytical initiatives and retailer/division-centric reporting that span across divisional categories.

Key Responsibilities:

The Sr. Analyst designs and deploys custom analytical solutions and team specific scorecards/dashboards to meet the unique needs of their Division Team. They serve as the analytical expert by leading multi-category requests and by providing insights and support to field sales leaders. The Sr. Analyst also plays a lead role on the Sales Analytics team, responsible for coaching, training, and onboarding Analysts.


Utilize multiple data sources to compile analysis and provide recommendations that drive positive ROI for the sales organization focusing on the so what, now what.
Strategize, advise and provide ad hoc support for VP/Director/Sr. Managers on opportunities for profitable growth
Identify team priorities and goals and develop trackers
Champion the use and application of standard sales analytics reports to meet the organization’s needs
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence Analysts to deliver best-in-class dashboards and scorecards for stakeholders
Provide superior customer service, being the point of contact for all faucets of sales analytics support


Division/Retailer Focused Insights & Reporting: Lead and provide retail/division-focused analytical support.


Translate complex business needs into actionable reporting, analytics, and insights that drive informed decision-making.
Maintain a holistic understanding of the wholesaler/retailer, category, and business landscape to proactively identify opportunities and improve selling capabilities.
Deliver actionable customer, category, and retail insights that support commercial planning, business planning, and sales execution.
Conduct root-cause, post-event, and benchmark analyses to evaluate performance, address business challenges, and identify growth opportunities.
Leverage internal, retail POS & movement data to provide fact-based recommendations, customer-facing selling tools, and category insights.
Support business performance through forecast accuracy, sales target attainment, segmentation, resource allocation, and customer service improvement.
Partner with CIH to transform 4Ps analytics and insights into business actions that drive growth.
Ensure timely and effective communication of customer, category, and forecast information to key stakeholders.


Elevate & Expand Sales Analytics Partnerships: Responsible for driving continuous improvement within the broader sales analytics tam through executing key projects and demonstrating peer-to-peer leadership. The Sr. Analyst will demonstrate role model behaviors within the sales analytics team by upskilling the analyst community through coaching and onboarding.


Owns and executes key sales analytics processes and provides sales analytics leadership with assistance on complex projects/initiatives.
Lead onboarding, provide continuous development, and fosters team collaboration for the Analysts on their respective sales analytics team
Own the deployment and training of sales analytics resources

Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Microsoft Fabric (35903)
Description:
Data Analyst – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.

,
