Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Microsoft Fabric (35903)
Description:
Data Analyst – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.

Title: Data Analyst (Nutricia + Kate Farms)
Description:
About The Job

Job Summary

The Data Analyst on the Enterprise Data Intelligence team turns data from across North America Medical Nutrition into trusted, actionable insights. In this role, you will partner with Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, Patient Services, and Medical/Regulatory teams to build reporting, analyze performance, and answer business questions that shape decisions. You will help make data accessible, consistent, and easier to use across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position


Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports in tools such as Power BI or Tableau, giving stakeholders clear visibility into sales, demand, patient and channel trends, and operational performance.
Analyze large, multi-source datasets, including sales, claims, syndicated, CRM, supply chain, and patient services data, to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Translate business questions into clear analytical requirements and communicate findings in concise, non-technical language.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
Partner with data engineers and data stewards to improve data pipelines, data models, and data quality.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis to improve accuracy and consistency across reports.
Support data governance practices, including metric definitions, documentation, data lineage, and a single source of truth for key performance indicators.
Handle sensitive data responsibly and follow applicable privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
Support ad hoc analysis and executive requests, prioritizing work based on business impact and urgency.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and contribute to team documentation, best practices, and continuous improvement.


Physical Demands & Work Environment


This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods.
The employee may be required to travel to Danone corporate offices as needed.


The salary range for this position is $76,000-133,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related field/equivalent experience.
2–4 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or analytics role.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical nutrition, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Experience with healthcare or commercial data sources, such as claims, syndicated data, CRM, specialty pharmacy, or distributor data, is preferred.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, data validation, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience with a business intelligence or visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable platform.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with cross-functional partners.
Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation is preferred.
Understanding data modeling, ETL/ELT concepts, data governance, and advanced Excel is preferred.
Demonstrates curiosity and ownership, business partnership, collaboration, clear communication, and integrity with data.


About us

Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet.

Danone North America is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Brief Description

About the Role:

The Junior Data Analyst will join the Data & Analytics team and support stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Finance, Purchasing, Business Development, and Engineering. The role centers on turning data into clear, reliable answers. That means working with business teams to understand their questions, analyzing data from across the company, keeping reporting accurate, and communicating findings in a way that supports decision-making. The role offers high visibility into company-wide processes. It's highly collaborative and suits someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of their work. This is an entry-level role for recent graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience.

What You Will Do


Write SQL queries against SQL Server to answer business questions and generate insights for Operations, Finance, Sales, and Business Development.
Use Python to clean, analyze, and automate work with data.
Handle ad hoc analysis requests from start to finish: clarify the question, pull and analyze the data, and present a clear answer.
Validate data accuracy across reports and source systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Use AI coding assistants and help build AI agents that automate recurring analysis and reporting.
Organize and reconcile data in Excel, mapping and merging data from multiple sources.
Support finance-related analysis such as inventory, cost, and margin reporting.
Monitor Power BI dashboards for data accuracy and refresh issues, escalating to the BI development team as needed.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within datasets and flag them proactively.
Prepare data and visuals for internal and external-facing decks and reports.
Document data definitions, query logic, and recurring processes.
Manage and prioritize requests from multiple teams.


Requirements

We are Seeking People Who:


Have a bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related computational or quantitative field.
Have up to one year of professional experience. Recent graduates are welcome.
Have hands-on experience from a data-related internship or personal projects, with work they can share, such as a GitHub repository or portfolio.
Are knowledgeable in SQL and can write queries, including joins and aggregations, to answer business questions.
Can write Python code for data analysis, using libraries such as pandas.
Understand at least one BI tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Are proficient in Excel.
Have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Are eager to learn new tools and technologies in a fast-paced environment.
Have high attention to detail and are comfortable working with large datasets.
Have exposure to Microsoft Fabric through coursework or personal projects, which is a plus.
Understand data flows and architecture, which is a plus.
Have completed coursework in data analysis, statistics, or business intelligence, which is a plus.
Have an interest in the wireless, electronics, distribution, or supply chain industry, which is a plus.


What's In It For You


Salary Range: $65,000 to $75,000 per year
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A supportive and collaborative work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package.
A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
A scaling company with great industry professionals.
Amazing opportunities to get involved with exciting projects at significant scale with some of the leading global companies.


Work Location / Type:


This role is on-site, and the candidate needs to be within commuting distance of Florham Park, NJ.
Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Description

University Health Network (UHN) is hiring a Data Analyst to work in the growing field of Healthcare Value Based Care. Remote Work Opportunity

Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
Onsite Fitness Center

401K Match with Immediate Vesting

Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).

Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.

Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders

Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support


Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.


Program Performance Analytics


Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.


Requirements

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the healthcare industry.
Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.


Personal Attributes


Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.


What Success Looks Like


The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.

FLSA: Exempt

Title: Surest Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Explore opportunities with Surest, a UnitedHealthcare Company (formerly Bind). We provide a new approach to health benefits designed to make it easier and more affordable for people to access health care services. Our innovative company is part tech start-up, part ground-breaking service delivery, changing the way benefits serve customers and consumers to deliver meaningful results and better outcomes (and we have just begun). We understand our members and employers alike desire a user-friendly, intuitive experience that puts people in control when it comes to the choices they make and the costs they pay for medical care. At Surest, we pride ourselves in our ability to make a difference, and with the backing of our parent company, UnitedHealthcare, we can operate in the best of both worlds - the culture and pace of an innovative start-up with big company support and stability. Come join the Surest team and discover the meaning behind Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

This Senior Data Analyst role will pay a critical function within the Surest Ontology Team to support the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Surest's Ontology and Search experience. Surest Ontology is the foundational framework and source of truth that Surest uses to organize, define, price, display, and adjudicate healthcare services across the member experience. This role is responsible for translating complex healthcare and benefit design data to improve search relevance, ontology accuracy, and downstream operational outcomes. This individual will partner closely with Product, Technology, Operations, and Benefit Design to ensure that Ontology structures and Search logic align with business intent and consumer needs.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze Ontology structures to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for optimization
Provide analytical support for Ontology changes, including upstream inputs and downstream dependencies
Implementation of Search data enhancements
Develop repeatable analyses to validate data integrity and configuration accuracy
Analyze search behavior, query patterns, and user interaction data to identify opportunities to improve search relevance and accuracy
Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for business and technical stakeholders
Establish and maintain data quality checks for Ontology and search data
Support documentation and standardization of analytical methodologies


You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications


5+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in healthcare, insurance or digital product environments
5+ years of experience with data modeling concepts
5+ years of experience using SQL and relational databases
5+ years of experience with Python or R for data analysis
3+ years of demonstrated experience working with healthcare administrative data (e.g. claims, encounter, clinical, provider etc.)
Demonstrated working knowledge of clinical data domains, code sets and ontologies (e.g. ICD, SNOMED, RxNorm)
Willing and able to travel 10% +/- depending on business need


Preferred Qualifications


1+ year experience with cloud computing (AWS, Azure) and data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake
Experience working with search platforms, search analytics, or relevance tuning
Experience presenting research methods and findings to stakeholders
Familiarity with taxonomy
Proven exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a highly dynamic environment
Proven high attention to detail
Proven innate curiosity to learn more
All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy


Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

Title: Data Analyst - eCommerce Analytics
Description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst - eCommerce Analytics to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. As Data Analyst – eCommerce Analytics, your primary responsibility will be to extract actionable insights from data to optimize ecommerce performance with insights from site content, promotions, customer behavioral data, marketing strategies, and market data, just to name a few. You will collaborate with ecommerce product management, category management, and site operations teams to drive data-driven decisions. The primary goal is providing insights for the ecommerce and marketing teams to guide, monitor and measure their strategies.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities


Data Collection: Partner with operations to track customer actions on the website through Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.
Data Analysis: Dive deep into customer behavior data in Google Analytics, sales data in Snowflake, and aggregated data in Power BI dashboards to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities to increase conversion, average order value, and traffic.
Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful dashboards via Power Bi, Looker Studio, and Excel Pivots.
Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Collaborate: Partner with data engineering, ecommerce teams, and across analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.


What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
Minimum of 3 years career experience in ecommerce or analytics.
Google Analytics: Proficiency in analyzing data in GA is required.
SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.
Data Visualization: Experience visualizing insights effectively using Power BI, Tableau or similar tools (Power BI is Preferred)


Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands


Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment.
Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location.


Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go to mytbtotalrewards.com.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:


Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development.
Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend.
Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday.


The starting salary for this position is $70,200 – $110,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $146,300. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Established in 2021, Independence Pet Holdings is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Clarus is a subsidiary of Doubtless, formerly known as Independence Pet Holdings, Inc. Clarus is a pioneering pet health technology company transforming the future of pet healthcare. We develop connected solutions across the pet health landscape, helping veterinary teams and pet owners make more informed care and financial decisions. Together, we are reducing complexity and helping more pets receive the care they need.

Job Summary

Clarus is seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Data Analyst to join the Analytics team. This individual will serve as a strategic analytical partner to Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and teams across the organization to deliver analytical solutions.

The Senior Data Analyst will bring together sales, CRM, customer, campaign, product usage, and engagement data to create reliable forecasts, dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights. The role will help Clarus improve pipeline visibility, commercial performance, customer retention, product adoption, and partner outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role with defined ownership and visibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and high-level business recommendations. They will bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify opportunities without waiting to be asked, and communicate insights in a way that drives action.

Job Location: Remote – USA. Candidates in EST/CST time zones are strongly preferred. US travel required.

Main Responsibilities


Gather reporting requirements and translate business questions into dashboards, reports, datasets, queries, metrics, and analytical models.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Zoho Analytics, or similar platforms.
Create reusable datasets, SQL queries, and data models that improve consistency and reduce manual reporting.
Establish and document KPI definitions, calculation logic, reporting assumptions, and data sources.
Design reporting assets that are accurate, intuitive, scalable, and appropriate for both operational and executive audiences.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, and leadership to define analytical needs and improve decision-making.
Balance recurring reporting responsibilities with ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
Evaluate lead management performance, including lead sources, routing, follow-up activity, aging, conversion, and pipeline leakage.
Monitor sales activity, account performance, customer engagement, revenue trends, renewals, expansion, and churn.
Analyze Sales performance drivers, growth trends, and areas of underperformance across accounts, customer segments, cohorts, channels, and external partners.
Build and maintain customer health scoring methodologies, including risk signals, adoption indicators, monitoring engagement behavior, and recommended calls to action.
Analyze the customer lifecycle across acquisition, activation, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, expansion, and churn.
Analyze user activity and product engagement to support Product decisions, Customer Success planning, and customer or partner reporting.
Develop customer performance scorecards for account reviews, renewal planning, and internal and external QBRs.
Analyze marketing campaign performance, including reach, engagement, lead quality, conversion, cohort performance, attribution, and downstream pipeline impact.
Prepare executive-ready summaries, presentations, scorecards, and reporting packages for leadership meetings, QBRs, partner reviews, and planning sessions.
Proactively identify gaps in data quality, reporting visibility, customer segmentation, and metric definitions.
Drive adoption of dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and reporting processes through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or higher in analytics, business, economics, statistics, finance, information systems, marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A strong record of success in sales analytics, revenue analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role.
5+ years of relevant experience is preferred; with demonstrated industry knowledge, analytical ability, initiative, and business impact.
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Experience building business dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Zoho Analytics or another CRM-connected analytics platform.
Experience analyzing CRM data, sales pipelines, funnels, customer activity, and commercial performance.
Strong understanding of forecasting, segmentation, conversion, retention, renewal, churn, and customer lifecycle metrics.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear analytical deliverables.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting findings to senior leaders and non-technical audiences.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, documentation, and reporting quality.


Preferred Qualifications


Relevant experience in animal health, veterinary services, pet insurance, insurance, SaaS, fintech, health technology, or similar environment highly desired.
Intellectually curious, resourceful, and motivated to understand how the business works.
Takes initiative, identify needs early, and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
Comfortable operating in an evolving, high-growth environment.
Can move easily between hands-on analysis, stakeholder conversations, and executive-level communication.
Able to manage deliverables while continuing to improve the underlying processes.
Able to build trust by producing accurate work, communicating clearly, and following through on commitments.


Compensation


Chicago Base pay range: $100,458 – $125,574 per year
New York Base pay range: $109,509 - $136,990 per year
Nationwide Base pay range: $91,325 - $114,158 per year


This is the range we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Placement within the range depends on job-related factors such as experience, skills, and certifications. This position is not eligible for an annual bonus. Base pay is one part of a total rewards package that includes the benefits listed below.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.

Title: Surest Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Explore opportunities with Surest, a UnitedHealthcare Company (formerly Bind). We provide a new approach to health benefits designed to make it easier and more affordable for people to access health care services. Our innovative company is part tech start-up, part ground-breaking service delivery, changing the way benefits serve customers and consumers to deliver meaningful results and better outcomes (and we have just begun). We understand our members and employers alike desire a user-friendly, intuitive experience that puts people in control when it comes to the choices they make and the costs they pay for medical care. At Surest, we pride ourselves in our ability to make a difference, and with the backing of our parent company, UnitedHealthcare, we can operate in the best of both worlds - the culture and pace of an innovative start-up with big company support and stability. Come join the Surest team and discover the meaning behind Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

This Senior Data Analyst role will pay a critical function within the Surest Ontology Team to support the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Surest's Ontology and Search experience. Surest Ontology is the foundational framework and source of truth that Surest uses to organize, define, price, display, and adjudicate healthcare services across the member experience. This role is responsible for translating complex healthcare and benefit design data to improve search relevance, ontology accuracy, and downstream operational outcomes. This individual will partner closely with Product, Technology, Operations, and Benefit Design to ensure that Ontology structures and Search logic align with business intent and consumer needs.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze Ontology structures to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for optimization
Provide analytical support for Ontology changes, including upstream inputs and downstream dependencies
Implementation of Search data enhancements
Develop repeatable analyses to validate data integrity and configuration accuracy
Analyze search behavior, query patterns, and user interaction data to identify opportunities to improve search relevance and accuracy
Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for business and technical stakeholders
Establish and maintain data quality checks for Ontology and search data
Support documentation and standardization of analytical methodologies


You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications


5+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in healthcare, insurance or digital product environments
5+ years of experience with data modeling concepts
5+ years of experience using SQL and relational databases
5+ years of experience with Python or R for data analysis
3+ years of demonstrated experience working with healthcare administrative data (e.g. claims, encounter, clinical, provider etc.)
Demonstrated working knowledge of clinical data domains, code sets and ontologies (e.g. ICD, SNOMED, RxNorm)
Willing and able to travel 10% +/- depending on business need


Preferred Qualifications


1+ year experience with cloud computing (AWS, Azure) and data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake
Experience working with search platforms, search analytics, or relevance tuning
Experience presenting research methods and findings to stakeholders
Familiarity with taxonomy
Proven exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a highly dynamic environment
Proven high attention to detail
Proven innate curiosity to learn more
All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy


Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Participer à des projets d'amélioration continue et de modernisation des solutions data.
Évoluer dans un environnement Agile et collaboratif.

Excellente maîtrise de SQL.
Expérience pratique avec AWS, notamment avec certains des services suivants :
Amazon S3
Amazon Athena
Amazon Redshift
AWS Glue
Expérience avec des outils de BI et de visualisation, tels que :
Power BI
Tableau
ou outils similaires.
Expérience dans l'analyse de données et la production de business insights.
Bonne compréhension des bases de données relationnelles et des concepts de data warehousing.
Expérience avec Python est un atout.
Excellentes capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes.
Capacité à communiquer des résultats techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Expérience dans un environnement Agile.
Français et anglais professionnels.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Corporate Overview



Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems; you will be expected to communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions
Develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making
Leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment
Dive into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth
You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems
Communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Requirements

3+years of experience in an analytical role is required
Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders
Ability to digest disparate datasets and visualize key trends or takeaways from raw datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to synthesize key takeaways and present data-proven results
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills including abnormality detection, predictive analysis, market segmentation, and competitive analysis.
Experience in using SQL with enterprise datasets is required
Experience in R or Python is required
Experience with Tableau or other related Business Intelligence Tool is required
Experience with automation in an enterprise setting is a major place

This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.

Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience writing complex queries.
Strong Python development skills, including working with notebooks, expertise with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), and use of visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Matplotlib).
Experience building dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Streamlit, or Django.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms and services; Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric experience preferred.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen
Visionary in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Application Security Testing

Company Wellness days - We shut down company operations during some days of the year (5 in total) to enable all employees to pursue personal growth and enjoy much-needed and deserved additional rest.

Title: Senior Data Analyst

The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with


Confido provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compensation Range: $175K - $210K

Title: Data Analyst (Nutricia + Kate Farms)
Description:
About The Job

Job Summary

The Data Analyst on the Enterprise Data Intelligence team turns data from across North America Medical Nutrition into trusted, actionable insights. In this role, you will partner with Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, Patient Services, and Medical/Regulatory teams to build reporting, analyze performance, and answer business questions that shape decisions. You will help make data accessible, consistent, and easier to use across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position


Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports in tools such as Power BI or Tableau, giving stakeholders clear visibility into sales, demand, patient and channel trends, and operational performance.
Analyze large, multi-source datasets, including sales, claims, syndicated, CRM, supply chain, and patient services data, to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Translate business questions into clear analytical requirements and communicate findings in concise, non-technical language.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
Partner with data engineers and data stewards to improve data pipelines, data models, and data quality.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis to improve accuracy and consistency across reports.
Support data governance practices, including metric definitions, documentation, data lineage, and a single source of truth for key performance indicators.
Handle sensitive data responsibly and follow applicable privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
Support ad hoc analysis and executive requests, prioritizing work based on business impact and urgency.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and contribute to team documentation, best practices, and continuous improvement.


Physical Demands & Work Environment


This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods.
The employee may be required to travel to Danone corporate offices as needed.


The salary range for this position is $76,000-133,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related field/equivalent experience.
2–4 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or analytics role.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical nutrition, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Experience with healthcare or commercial data sources, such as claims, syndicated data, CRM, specialty pharmacy, or distributor data, is preferred.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, data validation, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience with a business intelligence or visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable platform.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with cross-functional partners.
Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation is preferred.
Understanding data modeling, ETL/ELT concepts, data governance, and advanced Excel is preferred.
Demonstrates curiosity and ownership, business partnership, collaboration, clear communication, and integrity with data.


About us

Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet.

It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law.
