Title: Data Analyst - Finance
Description:
The Data Analyst provides analytical and organizational support to the Finance operations/management. They are proficient in data processing and report development, as well as scripting languages, including Python and SQL. Capable of creating, developing, testing, and deploying highly adaptive tools and reports used to support business. Responsible for conducting data analysis, analyzing trends, and creating visualizations and dashboards. The Data Analyst will be expected to understand established procedures and recommend improvements. The Data Analyst can self-manage tasks, projects, and complete them in a timely manner under general supervision.

Job Duties


Under general supervision develop SQL scripts and long-term reporting using a variety of data analysis tools / languages (SQL, Teradata, Tableau, and Excel). Identify and analyze trends with root cause analysis while providing solutions.
Provide ad hoc data analysis in a variety of source systems and using a variety of data analysis tools/ languages (SQL, Teradata, Tableau, Excel, Access).
Design, build, and maintain a predictive churn model. Develop internal reports on key indicators of churn, including ad-hoc reports as needed. Organize projects clearly with accurate plan for speed of delivery of initiatives.
Document existing and newly created processes for implementation in production systems.
Meet with Team and Management concerning semi-complex production reporting and enhancements. Provides detail regarding challenges and offer solutions and recommendations.
Collaborate with other Business Units such as Big Data, Marketing, and Product Management to accomplish common goals and objectives.
This position operates under close guidance of a Senior resource. Work requires extensive knowledge in AWS, Snowflake, and SQL databases with data mining knowledge as well as data visualization through Tableau. Work regularly requires the exercise of discretion and independent judgment in areas such as:
Querying large data sets, validating data, and performing User Acceptance Testing.
Developing specialized reports/dashboards.
Troubleshooting data issues.
Developing solutions to complex data issues.
Formulation of calculations to compute incentives, goals, forecasts.


Qualifications


Bachelors Equivalent combination of education and experience.
1-3 years Experience in a traditional data or analytics corporate environment.
1-3 years Experience in providing qualitative or quantitative data compilation, analysis and reporting.
1-3 years Experience with manipulating data with SQL, Python, R or related technologies.
Professional verbal and written communication skills required.
Strong SQL skills with data mining knowledge.
Advanced Excel skills (incl. VBA, macros, complex calculations, etc.).
Tableau preferred.
Python preferred.
Experience in statistical churn model a plus.
Able to rapidly learn new processes, databases, applications.

Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques
Concevoir et fournir des rapports, des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et des visualisations, en garantissant l'intégrité des données provenant de multiples sources
Extraire, compiler et agréger des données issues de multiples sources afin de les présenter sous un format simple et intuitif, qui sera utilisé dans les rapports et les présentations
Compiler les exigences relatives aux rapports récurrents en vue de leur automatisation dans Power BI et participer à leur test une fois développés
Élaborer et exécuter des plans de test, résoudre les problèmes et améliorer en continu les rapports et tableaux de bord BI
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes techniques internes (par exemple, Digital Information) pour garantir la livraison en temps voulu des modèles de données, une communication claire et la résolution des obstacles
Contribuer à la production de rapports ponctuels et ad hoc basés sur des données provenant de différentes sources

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

About The Company

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.

In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

Our Company Values Guide Our Daily Actions


Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.


We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.

STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.

Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.

Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

About The Company

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.

In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

Our Company Values Guide Our Daily Actions

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.

STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.

Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.

Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Analyst, Commercial Analytics
Description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK, data is how we make better decisions for travelers and partners alike — and the Commercial Analytics team is at the center of that work. As an Analyst on this globally distributed team, you'll help turn commercial data into clear, actionable insights that directly support revenue decisions across flights, hotels, cars, and advertising, working closely with colleagues across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will


Analyze commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers across travel verticals including flights, hotels, cars, and advertising
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization and reporting tools to give commercial teams timely visibility into business performance
Respond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from commercial teams
Monitor data accuracy, troubleshoot discrepancies, and maintain reporting reliability across existing data sources
Define and document key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with commercial teams, and build models to support forecasting and goal-setting
Collaborate with data engineering and business intelligence colleagues to ensure data quality and translate commercial reporting needs into technical requirements
Contribute to global analytics projects such as inventory forecasting, partner-facing reporting tools, and the development of AI-assisted analytics solutions
Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior commercial leaders.


Please Apply If You Have


At least 2 years of experience working with data in an analytical, business intelligence, operations, or similar role — we value demonstrated ability and transferable skills; equivalent experience, training, or self-directed learning is considered
At least 2 years of hands-on SQL experience, writing queries to explore and manipulate large datasets
Hands-on experience with at least one data visualization or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Superset, Power BI, or a comparable platform)
The ability to communicate data findings clearly to people with varying levels of technical background, including in written summaries and presentations
Curiosity, attention to detail, and an enjoyment of working through ambiguous problems using data
Comfort working in a global, cross-functional environment with colleagues across multiple time zones


To Stand Out, You Also Have


Experience with Python or R for data manipulation, automation, or modeling
Familiarity with the travel, e-commerce, or digital advertising industry
Experience working with AI or agentic analytics tools
Exposure to large-scale data warehouse environments (e.g., Trino, Vertica, or similar).


Benefits And Perks


Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
No meeting Fridays
Paid parental leave
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
Paid volunteer time
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars
Leadership development
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
Travel Discounts
Employee Resource Groups
Competitive retirement and health plans
Free lunch 2 days per week
Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday socials, and more

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $90,000-$105,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need an accommodation for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Senior Health Data Analyst on the Compass Patient Team for Veeva Compass, you’ll focus on the health data in our Compass Patient data product.

Veeva Compass is our suite of data products, with Compass Patient including prescription and medical claims record-level data to support more broad de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases, like patient journey, market landscape, provider engagement, and more.

You’ll own health data investigations and improvements as part of our Product team. You’ll focus on three key areas:


Data Support - investigate internal and external questions and requests to understand data trends and behavior within customer-defined cohorts and across the network.
Data Quality - Define and track quality metrics in your target domain in dashboards, identify improvement opportunities, and work cross-functionally to document and share learnings.
Data Network Improvements - Collaboratively launch new features to continue to enhance our data in your target expertise area. You’ll focus on investigating, defining and testing productizable improvements that work at scale across billions of records.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about data and excited about working alongside Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Engineers, and QA to implement improvements to continue to enrich our data and drive product excellence.

What You’ll Do


Own the investigation and resolution of data observations and data questions driven by internal and external stakeholders
Understand our product pipeline and impact to data to identify improvements
Build standard templates and practices to streamline data quality in your target domains
Own key analytics projects in the data and feature roadmaps
Design new data analytics and data quality features & capabilities, including features such as match, merge, dedupe logic, value enrichment and reference mappings
Establish quality metrics and build dashboards to drive continuous improvement of our data products for key areas such as merging, payer data, lab, prescribers, etc.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing prescription data and medical claims data
Advanced SQL skills; able to query and manipulate relational databases
Knowledge of Industry Standard billing codes such as ICD, CPT/HCPCS, NDC
Experience documenting and presenting analytics results with stakeholders
Experience defining KPIs and building dashboards to measure success


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in commercial life science use cases
Experience in enterprise products


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Title: Business Analytics Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

CarGurus is seeking a Business Analytics Analyst to join the Business Analytics & Reporting team. This team is responsible for the analytical rigor behind reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling that enable day-to-day and strategic decisions. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious and an exceptional critical thinker; they can live in the data, understanding the logic and processes that generate it as well as detecting signals, diagnosing problems, proposing solutions, and predicting future behavior. They can then use their mastery to synthesize and convey important information to other parties and offer thoughtful ways in which things can be improved.

The Business Analytics Team has a wide remit at CarGurus. You’ll work with many departments, gaining a broad exposure to the operation of the business, and be asked to connect the dots between them. Your rich understanding, technical skills, and thought partnership will make you a highly sought-after contributor for a wide variety of stakeholders, including senior leaders.

What You'll Do


With the assistance of AI tools, conduct exploratory data analysis across disparate data sources to understand the performance of the business and identify potential opportunities and/or risks.
Be an active contributor in discussions with decision-makers, using cognitive empathy to understand their vantage point and incentives before using this understanding to structure and frame downstream work and resulting findings.
Use data to identify, validate, and uncover causal relationships of important business mechanisms.
Implement new metrics to evaluate business performance and/or experiments and build reports and dashboards to monitor and understand them.
Be a voice and advocate to use data to improve the quality of our decision-making.


What You'll Bring


BS or BA in computer science, mathematics, statistics, analytics, or economics, with equivalent analytical work experience or a MS degree in a relevant field of study.
2+ years of professional experience focused on analysis and reporting, including the use of data visualization tools, to influence understanding and decision-making.
Ability to understand systems and business goals to help modernize and innovate on present data structures and models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using hypothesis-driven analysis to solve questions and give guidance.
Fluent in SQL and an analytical tool; experience with Git, Python, and LLMs is a plus.
Some experience with data modeling and ETL concepts.
Proficient at working with data ambiguity to derive meaningful insights.
Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills.
Able to manage multiple projects effectively, set expectations with partners, and complete projects on time.


The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$76,000—$96,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

This is an excellent opportunity for an analyst who enjoys working with complex datasets, creating meaningful visualizations, and helping business leaders make informed decisions.

3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, statistics, informatics, or a related field
Experience working with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Excel, or similar reporting and visualization tools

Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into reporting and analytical solutions
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for business users

The Opportunity

Help set a broad company vision for the way we communicate data and our value proposition to clients

Qualifications



Here's What We're Looking For



5-7 years of experience in business intelligence, product management, data and analytics, or a related field
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams
Strong experience with business intelligence tools is required, with a preference for Looker and Sigma
Comfortable presenting to both internal and external stakeholders
Strong communication skills: You can make even the most complex data easy to comprehend

Experience working with client or CRM data (e.g. Salesforce) to build a unified view of client relationships and usage patterns

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
About The Opportunity

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop as an Analytics Engineer, Report Developer, and Business Analyst simultaneously. As a member of the Analytics team, you'll gain hands-on experience building data solutions, developing reporting assets, and delivering insights that help drive business decisions.

You'll have meaningful ownership of projects while working alongside experienced team members who provide technical guidance, business context, coaching, and mentorship. Our goal is to help you grow through real-world challenges, collaboration, and continuous learning.

We're looking for a curious, technically minded problem solver who enjoys learning, thrives on new challenges, and wants to make an impact through data.

Location Requirements


Note: W.B. Mason will not provide relocation assistance for this position.
This role will operate in a hybrid working environment, meaning employees will work partly remote and partly in-office, with in-office time required at least once per week. The primary in-office location for this role is located at our Corporate Headquarters Office in Brockton, MA.


Exciting Benefits Of a W.B. Mason Career


$60,000 - $70,000 salary
Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Plans with $0 deductible (in-network) for all plans, with various plan designs to meet you and your family's needs
Company-paid Cell Phone Plan with unlimited text, talk and data; add a family member for only $55/month per line!
Superior Dental / Vision coverage, FSAs, free EAP, Company-paid life insurance, 401(k) and more!


What Makes Someone Successful In This Role


Technically Curious - You enjoy understanding how systems, data, and technology work. You're excited to learn new tools, explore unfamiliar concepts, and continuously expand your skills.
Driven Learner - You are self-motivated and committed to continuous improvement. You actively seek opportunities to learn, grow, and take on new challenges.
Critical Thinker & Problem Solver - You enjoy figuring things out. You look beyond surface-level answers, ask thoughtful questions, and work through complex problems to find practical solutions.
Impact Oriented - You are motivated by making a difference. You care about understanding the business problem, delivering value, and helping others make better decisions.
Detail Oriented - You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work while maintaining momentum. You understand the balance between attention to detail and perfectionism.
Collaborative - You work effectively with teammates and business partners, openly share ideas, welcome feedback, and contribute to a positive team environment.
Coachable - You are receptive to feedback, eager to learn from experienced team members, and view guidance as an opportunity to accelerate your growth.


Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Analytics Engineering

Help build and maintain the data foundation that powers reporting and analysis across the organization.


Partner with senior team members to develop scalable data solutions
Develop and maintain data assets within Microsoft Fabric
Write SQL, SparkSQL, and PySpark code to transform and prepare data for reporting and analysis
Improve data quality, automation, and analytical processes


Report Development

Create reporting solutions that help stakeholders understand and act on data.


Develop and maintain Microsoft Fabric semantic models, dashboards, and reports
Create reporting solutions that track key performance indicators and business outcomes
Design clear visualizations that communicate trends, opportunities, and challenges
Continuously improve reporting through automation, standardization, and user feedback


Analysis

Use data to answer business questions and support decision making.


Analyze business problems using data-driven approaches
Identify trends, opportunities, and root causes
Routinely prepare and communicate analytical findings, insights, and recommendations to business stakeholders and executive leadership through verbal presentations and written communication.
Help translate analytical insights into actionable business decisions
Collaborate with teammates and business partners to solve problems and deliver results
Perform other duties and projects as assigned


Education And/or Experience


Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline
1 year of analytical experience through internships, cooperative education programs, academic projects, extracurricular activities, or full-time employment
Foundational understanding of SQL and Python-based coding concepts used to acquire, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations in Power BI or Tableau that transform data into clear, actionable insights for business users.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel to organize, transform, analyze, and visualize data in support of reporting and business decision making.


Preferred Qualifications


Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, SparkSQL, PySpark, or R through coursework, internships, projects, or professional experience
Experience developing semantic models and writing DAX calculations in Power BI
Experience using web analytics platforms such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics


Minimum Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, speak, and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is frequently required to use hands and fingers for data entry. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

Title: Analyst II, Casino Analytics
Description:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As an Analyst II, Casino Analytics, you'll turn data into decisive action that strengthens our operations and fuels smarter decision-making. You'll partner across teams to evaluate workflows, uncover emerging trends, and build reporting infrastructure that keeps our business running at scale. In this role, you'll translate complex analyses into clear insights that shape strategy, improve efficiency, and support high-impact initiatives across evolving products and markets. Your work will drive visibility, scalability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

What you'll do


Serve as a key analytics partner for Golden Nugget Online Gaming (GNOG) lifecycle promotions, using data-driven insights to shape strategies that engage, retain, and reactivate players throughout their journey.
Design and evaluate lifecycle promotional tests, measuring performance, incrementality, and profitability to recommend which offers to expand, optimize, or discontinue.
Leverage SQL to analyze large, complex datasets, uncovering trends in player behavior, game engagement, and lifetime value to deliver actionable business recommendations.
Build and maintain dashboards in Sigma to track key lifecycle and promotional performance metrics, while developing self-service reporting tools and automated solutions for stakeholders.
Partner with the broader Casino Analytics Team to support strategic lifecycle initiatives, including cross-sell opportunities between DraftKings Casino and Golden Nugget Online Gaming.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Customer Relationship Management, Revenue Operations, and Analytics, to identify opportunities to increase player value, strengthen retention, and improve promotional effectiveness.



What you'll bring


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.
At least 2 years of analytics or data science experience.
Familiarity with programming languages such as SQL, Python
Strong understanding of statistics and hypothesis testing; experience building models is a plus.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights for diverse audiences.
Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a demonstrated ability to uncover new insights from data.

Title: Data Analyst - Water Quality
Description:
What You’ll Be Doing

This position will contribute to the protection of healthy rivers, lakes, and coasts and ensure safe drinking water across the nation. As part of a team of dedicated professionals, the selected candidate will perform data analysis and research in support of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and other government agencies. They will deliver high-quality products and services to clients on projects related to surface water quality assessment, watershed planning, nonpoint source management, analysis of drinking water contamination, protection of drinking water sources, development of water regulations, administration of water-related grant programs, and water infrastructure planning.

This position requires previous professional experience with one or more Clean Water Act programs, such as nonpoint source pollution, assessment of surface water quality standards, impaired waters listing, or development of Total Maximum Daily Loads. Working with Safe Drinking Water Act programs is also a plus. Experience could come from a previous position with a government agency, consulting firm, or another organization involved with implementing federal water regulations. The selected candidate will apply their knowledge, skills, and experience to plan and complete tasks to identify, evaluate, and review sources of data and information; perform data cleaning, analysis, and visualization; write technical documents; and assist with developing educational, training, or outreach materials. Experience working with large environmental datasets and geospatial layers and using programming languages (R or Python) for data analysis is also required.

The position will interact with colleagues, clients, and external federal, state, and local entities to understand challenges, discuss solutions, present methods and results, and gather feedback.

This position can be based out of any Cadmus office location. A fully remote arrangement will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

Who We Are

Cadmus provides government, commercial, and other private organizations worldwide with technology-empowered advisory and implementation services. We help our clients achieve their goals and drive lasting, impactful change by leveraging transformative digital solutions and unparalleled expertise across domains.

At Cadmus, we look for team players and problem solvers who are driven to use their unique perspectives and intellectual curiosity to help deliver breakthrough solutions that achieve transformative goals. As a member of our team, you'll collaborate with leading experts to support our clients across the globe. We offer competitive compensation, outstanding health care and retirement benefits, a vibrant and collaborative work environment, and ample opportunities for professional growth.

Join Cadmus. Together, we are strengthening society and the natural world. For more information, visit cadmusgroup.com .

Responsibilities


Implement methods to clean, analyze, and store data using R.
Complete analysis of raster and vector geospatial data using ArcGIS software and the Python programming language.
Research and evaluate national, state, and local data sets for inclusion in water sector projects.
Assist in the development and maintenance of tools and dashboards for viewing and analyzing water-related data, including developing ArcGIS Online or Power BI products.
Develop appropriate data analysis documentation, including summaries of methodologies and results.
Perform literature reviews for topics relevant to the Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act and summarize literature review findings.
Provide quality control support when developing client deliverables.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, water resources management, geography, ecology, or a related discipline.
Between 2 to 4 years of relevant professional experience with a government agency, consulting firm, or other organization involved with implementing the Clean Water Act. A Master’s degree in a relevant field may substitute for 2 years of professional experience.
Experience retrieving and analyzing large environmental datasets and geospatial data layers, such as land use, demographic, ecological, hydrologic, and water sampling data.
Advanced skills in R and Python for data cleaning and analyzing large and complex datasets.
Experience working with raster and vector geospatial data using ArcGIS Pro software and ArcPy functions.
Familiarity with using ArcGIS Online, Power BI, or Shiny to develop interactive tools and dashboards for visualizing data.
Strong problem-solving skills with an ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to apply quality control practices.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with clients, stakeholders, and team members.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications.


Additional Information

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States as a U.S Perm Resident or U.S. Citizen.

Based on eligibility and job status, Cadmus offers an excellent benefits package to include: medical, dental, vision, company paid disability and life insurance, 401(k) program, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, voluntary time off (VTO), tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance program, other optional benefits and various bonus programs.

The salary range for this position is $70,000 - $85,000. The actual salary will be determined by several factors, including relevant work experience, education, skills, and market competitiveness.

We value the critical role safety and health protocols contribute to everyone’s success at Cadmus, and work together to align and comply with all federal, state, and local safety and health mandates to ensure a safe and valuable work environment.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning, Fender), major sports franchises (Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).




We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.




The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.




Who You Are:

You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any question
You bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basis
You are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plus
You communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaning
You have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus




What You’ll Do:

Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.
Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.
Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.




Work Environment

Gupta Media is an office-first organization.




Our Commitment

At Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.




Compensation

At Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.




We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.




Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

This role works in an environment that often requires the performance of multiple simultaneous activities, where competing deadlines need to be met, and work is performed under pressure while involving significant business commitments and results.

Technical Skills: Power BI & Excel

Title: Principal Business Insights Analyst
Description:
Description

The Principal Business Insights Analyst is a highly analytical and influential business partner responsible for turning complex performance data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that improve sales performance, productivity, and execution across the retail branch network. Reporting to the Principal Business Insights Director, this role works closely with Sales Leadership, Product teams, Field Execution leaders, and enterprise data and analytics partners to identify opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and help leaders make informed business decisions.

This individual will connect data to business outcomes, moving beyond reporting what happened to helping the organization understand why it happened, where opportunities exist, and what actions can improve performance. Through analysis of branch, regional, and national performance, the Principal Business Insights Analyst will provide recommendations that strengthen sales effectiveness, lead conversion, product penetration, and colleague productivity.

The role requires strong analytical capability, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling insights for both senior leaders and frontline business partners. The analyst will also help establish meaningful performance measures, evaluate the effectiveness of business initiatives, and continuously improve how insights are used to drive decisions and execution.

Primary Responsibilities Include

Performance Insights and Opportunity Identification


Analyze branch, regional, and national performance across key sales, conversion, productivity, and related business metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps.
Diagnose underlying drivers and root causes behind performance results and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, including sales per lead, conversion rates, product penetration, and colleague productivity.
Proactively surface emerging trends and performance opportunities to help leaders focus resources and actions where they can have the greatest business impact.


Sales and Initiative Effectiveness


Evaluate the effectiveness of sales initiatives, campaigns, and lead-management strategies and identify opportunities to strengthen performance.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators for priority initiatives, assessing results and recommending adjustments or optimizations based on performance.
Connect business results with underlying activities and execution to help leaders understand what is driving performance and where changes may be needed.


Executive Insights and Decision Support


Develop executive-level reporting, presentations, and data stories that translate complex analysis into clear business implications and recommended actions.
Communicate insights in a concise and compelling manner that enables both technical and non-technical audiences to understand the business opportunity and determine appropriate action.
Serve as a trusted analytical partner to business leaders, bringing an informed, data-driven perspective to strategic and frontline decisions.


Reporting, Dashboards and Data Integrity


Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reporting tools that support timely decision-making by field and senior leadership.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data used in reporting, analysis, and performance measurement.
Partner with enterprise data and analytics teams to strengthen reporting capabilities, improve data quality, and evolve the tools and insights available to business leaders.


Cross-Functional Partnership


Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product teams, Field Execution leaders, and enterprise data and analytics partners to align analytical work with key business priorities.
Translate business questions and emerging performance challenges into meaningful analysis that supports decision-making and execution.
Influence decisions through fact-based recommendations while building strong relationships across a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.


Required Qualifications

Qualifications, Education, Certifications and/or Other Professional Credentials


Demonstrated experience analyzing complex business and performance data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data, performance trends, and business activity to measurable outcomes.
Experience analyzing sales, conversion, productivity, customer, or related performance metrics in a business environment.
Demonstrated ability to identify trends, performance gaps, and root causes and communicate the business implications of those findings.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting, executive presentations, or other analytical tools that support business decision-making.
Strong communication and data-storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear insights for non-technical and senior audiences.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across business, sales, product, field, and data or analytics teams.
Strong attention to data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and proactively identify opportunities where analytics can improve business performance.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Retail Banking, Consumer Financial Services, branch distribution, sales performance, or another large-scale customer-facing business.
Experience evaluating sales initiatives, campaigns, lead-management strategies, or other programs tied to measurable business outcomes.
Experience establishing KPIs and measuring the effectiveness of strategic or operational initiatives.
Experience developing insights for a geographically distributed frontline organization.
Advanced experience with business intelligence, visualization, reporting, or analytical tools.


Hours & Work Schedule


Hours per Week: 40
Work Schedule: 8 AM – 5 PM


Pay Transparency


The salary range for this position is $139,000 - $182,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.
We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits.
