Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

Pay Range

$74,880.00 USD - $124,800.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies


Workday & People Data Expertise
Advanced People Analytics
Strategic Thinking
Data Architecture & Governance
Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
Executive Data Storytelling
Business Acumen
Stakeholder Influence
Data Visualization
Problem Solving
Innovation
Collaboration & Mentorship
Judgment & Discretion

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
  • Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
  • Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
  • Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
  • Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
  • Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.

People Analytics & Strategic Insights

  • Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
  • Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
  • Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
  • Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
  • Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.

Strategic Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
  • Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
  • Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
  • Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
  • Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.

Data Governance & Analytics Architecture

  • Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
  • Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
  • Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
  • Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
  • Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
  • Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.

Technical & Analytical Leadership

  • Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
  • Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
  • Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
  • Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
  • Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
  • Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
  • Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
  • Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
  • Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
  • Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
  • Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
  • Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
  • Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Title: Senior Business Insights Analyst, Branch Network Distribution
Description:
Description

Citizens Bank is undertaking a multi‑year transformation of its retail branch network, shifting from a cost‑focused footprint to a performance‑driven, growth‑oriented distribution model. The Senior Business Insights Analyst, Branch Network Distribution will play a central role in enabling that transformation.

This role is responsible for building and maintaining the core reporting, analytics, and management information used to measure and manage branch network performance. The analyst will develop insight across the banker, branch, market, and enterprise levels, translating complex data into clear, decision‑ready perspectives for senior leaders. Key stakeholders include the Head of Distribution Transformation, Head of the Retail Branch Network, and the Head of the Consumer Bank.

This is a hands‑on analytical role with meaningful exposure to executive leadership, requiring both technical depth and strong business judgment.

Key Responsibilities


Network Performance Reporting & Insights
Design, build, and maintain a comprehensive suite of reporting and dashboards that measure branch network performance using leading and lagging indicators.
Develop performance views across multiple levels (banker, branch, market, enterprise) to support day‑to‑day management and long‑term strategic decisions.
Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
Data Knowledge, Wrangling & Preparation
Develop deep understanding of branch, banker productivity, customer, and financial data domains.
Use advanced SQL and tools such as Alteryx (or equivalent) to source, cleanse, and prepare high‑quality analytical datasets.
Ensure consistency, accuracy, and clarity of metrics and definitions across reporting outputs.
Business Intelligence & Tool Expertise
Build and maintain semantic data models that enable efficient, scalable reporting and analysis.
Leverage multiple BI and visualization tools to deliver intuitive, decision‑ready insights.
Continuously improve automation, performance, and usability of reporting assets.
Business Partnering & Influence
Serve as a trusted analytical partner to Distribution and Consumer Bank leadership.
Anticipate stakeholder questions and frame insights to support effective decision‑making.
Provide thoughtful, data‑driven recommendations with clear implications and trade‑offs.
People & Project Leadership
Lead analytical initiatives end‑to‑end, including scoping, work planning, execution, and delivery.
Develop project plans, manage timelines, and provide clear status updates to stakeholders.
Mentor and coach junior analysts, helping elevate overall analytical capability.
Executive Communication
Produce polished, executive‑ready materials including presentations, memos, and summaries.
Distill complex analyses into concise narratives tailored to senior leadership audiences.
Ways of Working & Continuous Improvement
Operate independently with strong ownership and accountability for outcomes.
Identify and implement process improvements to increase speed, accuracy, and scalability.
Thoughtfully adopt GenAI tools to enhance analytical productivity while maintaining rigor and governance.

Qualifications


5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related role; financial services or retail banking experience preferred.
Advanced SQL proficiency; hands‑on experience with Alteryx or similar data preparation tools strongly preferred.
Strong experience with BI and visualization platforms and semantic modeling concepts.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear insights for senior leaders.
Experience leading projects and mentoring junior team members.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.


Leadership & Soft Skills


Insight‑driven — anticipates questions, connects dots, and delivers analysis that informs action.
Technically strong — combines analytical rigor with practical execution.
Executive‑ready communicator — translates complexity into clear, concise, decision‑focused messages.
Self‑directed — takes ownership, prioritizes effectively, and operates with minimal oversight.
Collaborative — builds strong relationships across functions and contributes positively to team outcomes.


Continuously curious — actively develops new skills and explores better ways to deliver insight and impact.


Preferred Qualifications
Master’s Degree in Business Administration

Hours & Work Schedule


Hours per Week: 40
Work Schedule: Monday - Friday
Hybrid: 4 days per week onsite, 1 day remote


Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $135,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits .

Title: Senior Analyst Sales Operations
Description:
Our world class sales and sales support teams work directly with businesses of all sizes to offer products and services to meet our customers’ unique needs. We are committed to understanding our customers and use best-in-class sales tools and technology to find the best solutions. We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.

The Senior Analyst, Sales Operations is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining analytical tools, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the sales organization. Partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and IT teams, this role helps define performance metrics, uncover business insights, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, profitability, and execution. The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities with business acumen and a passion for turning data into impactful recommendations.

Develop, automate, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into sales performance, pipeline health, revenue trends, and operational effectiveness.
Build and optimize data models and SQL queries to ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient reporting.
Create meaningful visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or similar business intelligence tools.
Partner with business leaders to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement frameworks for strategic initiatives.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Leverage automation and data preparation tools such as Alteryx to streamline reporting and analytics workflows.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reporting standardization, process optimization, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Collaborate with IT and data governance teams to ensure data quality, integrity, compliance, and security.
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership teams to support business decision-making.
Stay current on emerging analytics technologies and recommend innovative solutions that improve business outcomes.

Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to simplify complex information.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Collaborative, relationship-focused approach with strong cross-functional partnership skills.
Intellectual curiosity and a passion for leveraging data, technology, and automation to solve business challenges.
Ability to translate data into actionable insights that drive measurable business impact.


What’s Needed- Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, related analytical discipline, or equivalent work experience.
2+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, sales operations, or a related field.
Advanced SQL skills for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or similar platforms.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and data modeling.
Demonstrated experience defining business metrics and translating business requirements into analytical solutions.
Proven ability to build and maintain scalable reporting processes and frameworks.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.


What’s Needed - Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with Alteryx or similar workflow automation and data preparation tools.
Familiarity with Snowflake, Salesforce, enterprise data warehouses, or comparable technologies.
Understanding of sales performance measurement, forecasting, territory planning, and pipeline analytics.
Experience supporting data governance initiatives or self-service analytics programs.
Exposure to project management or continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Agile.
Experience working in a cross-functional environment supporting sales and business operations teams.

Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
Flexible PTO (22 days) and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Leader Bank is looking for exceptionally dedicated team members to join one of the region’s fastest growing community banks and mortgage lenders. At the time of its founding in 2002, Leader Bank had one branch office, $6.5 million in assets and 7 team members. Since then, the Bank has become one of the most successful banks in Massachusetts with more than $5 billion in assets, 450+ team members, 7 branch offices, and annual mortgage originations of over $2 billion.

Exemplary products and an innovative spirit have driven Leader Bank’s rapid growth over the years, and our team members embrace these values. Our mission is to obsess over our clients, make them feel valued, and maintain long-term relationships with them by constantly enhancing our products and processes to always improve our client experience. For our team members, Leader Bank prioritizes competitive compensation and benefits, a healthy work-life balance, and an environment that fosters diversity and inclusion.

Summary

At Leader Bank, we recognize that data is an opportunity to create better experiences, smarter decisions, and value for our clients. As a BI Analyst, you enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and turn insights into action through automation.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. This individual will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to transform raw data into trusted, actionable insights while establishing scalable reporting and governance practices.

Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and analytics-ready datasets in Snowflake.
Build and maintain data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and business metrics to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.
Develop scalable reporting architectures that support operational, analytical, and executive reporting needs.
Optimize data structures, queries, and warehouse performance for BI workloads.
Reporting & Visualization
Create and maintain dashboards, workflows and self-service reporting solutions using Retool, and other BI tools.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business questions into actionable analytics.
Develop executive-level dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful business insights.
Ensure data visualizations are intuitive, accurate, and aligned with organizational goals.
Data Engineering & Automation
Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes for structured and semi-structured data.
Build automated data validation, quality monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
Utilize Python, SQL, and JavaScript to automate reporting, data transformations, and analytics workflows.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance data ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
Governance & Quality
Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes.
Define and enforce data governance best practices, metadata management, and documentation standards.
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Promote adoption of trusted data sources and standardized reporting practices.
Collaboration
Work closely with business leaders, product managers, analysts, and engineering teams.
Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and solution design activities.
Provide guidance on analytics best practices, dashboard design, and data storytelling.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines.
3+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or other relational databases.
3+ years of experience building dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI/Tableau/Retool or similar BI platforms.
Strong SQL expertise including performance optimization, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design.
Strong Python programming experience for analytics, automation, and data processing.
Experience with JavaScript for dashboard customization, application development, and automation.
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.
Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with dbt, Matillion or similar modern data stack technologies.
Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
Knowledge of API development and integrations.
Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to improve analytics and reporting.
Snowflake, Power BI, or cloud certifications.

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.

Title: Associate Supply Chain Analyst
Description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.

ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.

About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

About The Role

Analog Devices is seeking a motivated Supply Chain Analyst to support global supply chain operations through data analysis, planning, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will help address complex supply chain challenges across areas such as demand and supply planning, inventory optimization, logistics, customer delivery, capacity planning, and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze supply chain data to identify trends, risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities across planning, logistics, inventory, customer delivery, and operations.
Support demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimization, capacity planning, logistics analysis, or customer delivery activities based on team needs.
Define, track, and report key supply chain metrics and KPIs to support data-driven decision-making.
Develop dashboards, reports, analytical models, and business insights using tools such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Partner with cross-functional teams including planning, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, customer operations, finance, and IT to resolve supply chain issues and improve processes.
Translate business requirements into clear analytical outputs, project deliverables, process improvements, or reporting solutions.
Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance supply chain visibility, operational efficiency, customer service, and planning accuracy.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and project updates to stakeholders across geographically distributed teams.


Must Have Skills


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and develop actionable insights.
Familiarity with supply chain concepts such as demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, logistics, procurement, capacity planning, or customer delivery.
Experience using Excel or similar tools for data analysis, reporting, and problem solving.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across teams and regions.
Relevant coursework, projects, internships, or work experience in supply chain, operations, analytics, or related fields.


Preferred Education And Experience


Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Operations, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
0-2 years of relevant experience in supply chain, operations, analytics, planning, logistics, procurement, customer operations, or related fields.
Experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, Python, or other analytics and visualization tools.
Exposure to ERP, planning, or supply chain systems such as SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, Kinaxis, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with supply chain metrics such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, service level, OTIF, lead time, backorders, capacity utilization, or fulfillment performance.
Exposure to process improvement, root cause analysis, project management, or continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience supporting dashboards, KPI reporting, data automation, scenario modeling, or operational analytics.
Interest in semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, or global supply chain operations.

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics
Description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst to provide advanced analytical support for our Contact Center Workforce Management (WFM) function.

This role will leverage workforce data, analytics, and technology to optimize staffing strategies, strengthen workforce planning, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making. The Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst will partner closely with HRBPs, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to translate complex workforce and operational data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and technical capabilities, an understanding of contact center and workforce management operations, and the ability to connect workforce insights with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Analytics & Insights


Collect, analyze, and interpret workforce and contact center operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that support workforce and operational decisions.
Conduct root cause analyses related to service levels, staffing, capacity, productivity, and workforce performance.
Identify emerging workforce trends and proactively recommend actions to improve operational effectiveness.
Partner with stakeholders to develop and enhance predictive models that improve workforce forecasting and planning.


Workforce Planning & Forecasting


Partner with WFM leaders to develop data-driven staffing and capacity models aligned with business objectives and operational requirements.
Provide analytical support for short- and long-term workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
Perform scenario modeling to evaluate the workforce implications of changes in demand, staffing, productivity, and business requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve staffing efficiency, capacity utilization, productivity, and cost management.
Support workforce forecasts and provide insights into potential staffing gaps, risks, and opportunities.


Reporting & Visualization


Develop and maintain workforce reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Workday, and other relevant technologies.
Establish and maintain accurate, consistent, and reliable workforce metrics across reporting processes and data sources.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready insights.
Present complex information in a concise and understandable format for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to automate and improve workforce reporting and analytics.


Performance & Optimization


Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to workforce efficiency, service levels, productivity, capacity, and operational effectiveness.
Monitor performance trends and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.
Benchmark performance against internal targets and relevant industry standards to inform workforce strategies.
Recommend process improvements that strengthen WFM operations and overall organizational effectiveness.
Measure the impact of workforce initiatives and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.


Technology & Data Enablement


Leverage Workday and workforce management/contact center platforms, including AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or similar technologies, to support workforce analytics, forecasting, scheduling, reporting, and decision-making.
Utilize Workday workforce and organizational data alongside operational data sources to develop integrated workforce insights and reporting.
Utilize advanced analytics tools and enterprise data platforms to improve the accuracy, accessibility, and usability of workforce information.
Support the implementation and integration of new tools, technologies, and processes that strengthen workforce analytics capabilities.
Partner with HR, HRBPs, Technology, Operations, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and system capabilities.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and increase the scalability of workforce analytics.


Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Workforce Management, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field.
Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in workforce analytics, workforce management, contact center operations, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience using workforce data and analytics to support operational and business decision-making.
Experience working within a complex, cross-functional organization preferred.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Excel, with experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical models.
Experience working with Workday, including workforce, organizational, and employee data for reporting and analytics.
Experience with workforce management or contact center technologies such as AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of forecasting methodologies, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and data mining.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and analyze data from multiple sources and translate complex datasets into meaningful business insights.
Experience with data visualization, reporting automation, and analytical storytelling.


Core Capabilities


Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently identify issues, analyze alternatives, and recommend solutions.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect workforce analytics with broader business and operational priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse audiences.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Ability to influence decisions through data, insights, and fact-based recommendations.
Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.


Physical Requirements And Work Environment

This role requires the ability to perform standard office activities, including extended periods of computer use, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and collaboration across teams. Depending on business needs, occasional travel may be required. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on the requirements of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this role is $90,000-$130,000 per year. This range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role. Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Compensation decisions are made based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and the totality of relevant factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in an annual short-term incentive program, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Benefits

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

Work Authorization

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

What We Offer

At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

Next Steps


If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team


Don't meet every single requirement? At Galderma, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply anyway!

If you are considering employment at Galderma, review our job postings at www.galderma.com/us/careers. Please be aware of fraudulent job offers and individuals falsely claiming to represent our Human Resources department. Our company will never request or offer payment, personal financial information, or sensitive data (such as Social Security numbers or bank details) during the early stages of recruitment. All legitimate communications from our HR team will come from official company email domains and follow our established hiring process.

Title: Biomedical Data Analyst
Description:
About LifeCanvas Technologies




LifeCanvas Technologies, an MIT spinoff venture, is revolutionizing the way we see and study biological systems. LifeCanvas offers cutting-edge technologies and end-to-end solutions that enable holistic molecular imaging of biological systems, accelerating breakthrough discoveries in science and the development of new therapeutic strategies. As a key partner in this global effort, our computational team works on enabling scientific innovation and directly collaborates with global researchers in bioengineering, neuroscience, and oncology.




Job Summary

We are seeking an ambitious and motivated Biomedical Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with biomedical data analysis, machine learning, or scientific computing, and a strong interest in building scalable software solutions for both research and industrial applications in a fast-paced start-up environment. In this role, you will support the analysis of large-scale 3D fluorescence microscopy datasets generated by LifeCanvas Technologies. You will work closely with our tissue processing, image acquisition, and Contract Research teams to run analyses, validate outputs, troubleshoot issues, and help generate high-quality quantitative results for internal teams and external scientific partners.




Key Responsibilities:

Run, validate, and troubleshoot analyses for Contract Research projects, ensuring accurate results and timely project completion.
Perform quality control on analysis outputs to validate results.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth data acquisition, integration, and downstream analysis.
Communicate analytical findings clearly to internal teams and external scientific partners.
Assist with maintaining and improving components of LifeCanvas image-analysis pipelines for large-scale 3D fluorescence microscopy datasets.
Support the development of data engineering workflows, including database management, ETL processes, and handling of large imaging datasets.




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, bioengineering, computational biology, electrical engineering, or a relevant field.
Experience with image processing for biological and/or biomedical applications
Experience using Python for data science, scientific computing, automation, and image analysis.
Strong problem-solving skills with a self-motivated and detail-oriented mindset and the ability to work in a team environment.
Adaptable and proactive in a fast-paced environment, comfortable working across multiple concurrent projects and evolving requirements.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.




Preferred Qualifications:

Familiarity with light microscopy, neuroscience, and immunohistochemistry
Familiarity with best practices for software engineering.
Exposure to machine learning or deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience in working with data engineering/analysis pipelines.




Benefits:

Competitive salary.
Full insurance package for full-time employees.
Flexible time off.
401(k) benefits.

Title: Operations & Analytics Associate
Description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Position Summary

KKR is hiring for an enterprise Data Operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. The Data Operations Center of Excellence (CoE) is a cross-functional team dedicated to formulating and driving KKR's enterprise data strategy while also providing the operating leverage required to bring these strategies and frameworks to life.

The Data Operations CoE is seeking to hire an Associate / Senior Analyst to support Analytics efforts across Private Markets and Credit. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders and technology partners to build analytical models, data products, and lightweight tools that go beyond static reporting, translating complex data into clear, actionable insight for investment and operational decision-makers. This is a hands-on role where the candidate should expect to be writing SQL and Python, building and testing models, and developing tools directly.

The ideal candidate would have the unique combination of strong data analysis and data science skills, genuine comfort building tools and applications, and the interpersonal polish to engage confidently with senior leadership. The candidate should have a passion/interest in private markets and credit investing, an interest in embracing new technologies (AI), strong verbal/written communication skills, and be a good cultural fit with an emphasis on collaboration, excellence, and action-oriented results.

Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain analytical models, data products, and lightweight tools that support Private Markets and Credit investment teams, going beyond static reporting to surface original, actionable insight
Serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, gathering requirements, defining analytical use cases, and ensuring delivered solutions meet business needs
Write and optimize complex SQL queries and Python-based scripts to extract, transform, model, and analyze data across multiple sources and platforms, ensuring data quality and consistency
Partner closely with data engineering, technology, and operations teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that underpin analytics, modeling, and tool development
Develop domain expertise in private markets and credit data, including deal, portfolio, fund, and investor data, and apply that knowledge to improve data coverage, quality, and analytical depth
Identify opportunities to streamline manual workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve the efficiency and reliability of data processes across the team
Explore and apply AI tools, large language models, and emerging technologies to build new analytical capabilities and unlock new insight for the business
Collaborate with team members across offices and time zones in support of these initiatives


Qualifications


4+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics, data science, or a related field, ideally within financial services, private equity, credit, or a comparable institutional environment
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with demonstrated ability to independently build data models, analytical pipelines, and tools
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent cloud data warehouse) and BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Sigma, Tableau) as part of a broader analytical toolkit
Demonstrated ability to work in business-facing roles, translating stakeholder needs into analytical frameworks & tools
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex data into insight for both technical and non-technical audiences
Intellectual curiosity and interest in private markets, credit, and alternative investments
Strong cultural fit – collaborative, intellectually curious, action-oriented, and committed to high standards of excellence and accountability
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with a proactive, self-starter mindset and high attention to detail


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience in private markets, credit, or alternative investment data and analytics or background in financial services, asset management, or fintech
Experience building internal applications or tools (e.g., Python-based apps, low-code platforms, or AI-assisted development) to deliver data products beyond dashboards
Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, or large language models to improve business workflows and data processes
Working understanding of dbt for managing data transformations, building modular analytics pipelines, and maintaining well-tested, version-controlled data models
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows

$100,000—$130,000 USD

Title: Data Analytics Specialist
Description:
Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Associate Director of Data Analytics and Insights on the Data Engineering and Operations team, the Data Analytics Specialist supports Bentley University’s enterprise data and analytics ecosystem by translating business needs into well-defined data requirements, building and maintaining trusted reporting and dashboard solutions, and partnering with data engineering and business teams to deliver scalable data products. The role combines business analysis, BI development, data modeling, testing, and hands-on engineering support across the analytics delivery lifecycle. The position may apply statistical, predictive, or machine learning techniques when they are appropriate to the business need, while maintaining a primary focus on reliable data, actionable analysis, and decision-ready reporting.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Data Requirements


Collaborate with business partners, cross-functional teams, and IT units to gather, clarify, and document detailed business, data, and reporting requirements.
Translate business needs into technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, semantic model requirements, and analytics deliverables.
Lead or support stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, process mapping, workflow analysis, and use-case development.
Conduct data discovery and profiling to understand source systems, data structures, data quality, lineage, and end-to-end data movement.
Research and work with the data governance manager to resolve complex questions related to enterprise reporting, data definitions, business rules, and data usage across systems.
Partner with data governance stakeholders to define shared terminology, document data definitions, and promote consistent and responsible data use.


Reporting, Dashboards & BI Development


Analyze, define, design, build, test, deploy, and maintain reports and interactive dashboards across BI platforms, including Power BI and SQL-based outputs.
Develop and maintain semantic models, relationships, calculations, queries, and measures using Power BI, DAX, Power Query (M), and SQL.
Create intuitive data visualizations that communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and support data-informed decision-making.
Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and actionable insights.
Apply predictive analytics, machine learning, or other advanced analytical methods selectively when they add clear value; evaluate results and communicate limitations appropriately.
Provide dashboard prototyping, iterative refinement, performance optimization, release support, and ongoing maintenance across the full BI development lifecycle.
Provide training, documentation, and ongoing support to report consumers and business users.
Identify opportunities for business process optimization, reporting consolidation, self-service enablement, and data quality improvement.
Support continuous improvement of dashboard standards, naming conventions, documentation expectations, accessibility practices, and BI development best practices.


Data Engineering & Analytics Enablement


Collaborate with data engineers to design, refine, test, and monitor data pipelines and curated datasets that support enterprise analytics.
Develop and maintain data transformations, reusable queries, data models, and analytics-ready structures across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources.
Validate data completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency across source systems, pipelines, semantic models, and reports; document and help resolve data quality issues.
Support ETL/ELT workflows, data integration requirements, source-to-target mappings, and troubleshooting of data movement across the Azure data ecosystem.
Contribute to scalable, maintainable analytics solutions through sound development practices, technical documentation, version control, deployment discipline, and monitoring.


System Testing & Project Delivery


Coordinate and perform testing to confirm that documented requirements and quality expectations are met.
Develop test plans, test cases, expected results, reconciliation approaches, and supporting evidence for data and BI solutions.
Manage and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), track issues through resolution, validate corrections, and obtain end-user approval.
Support project delivery lifecycle activities, including estimation, design review, backlog refinement, documentation, release readiness, and training.
Communicate status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and data issues to project stakeholders and delivery partners.
Balance multiple concurrent priorities while meeting agreed-upon delivery commitments and maintaining solution quality.


Documentation, Governance & Continuous Improvement


Create and maintain business requirements documents, technical requirements documents, data dictionaries, process flows, source-to-target mappings, test documentation, release notes, and user guides.
Ensure solutions align with confidentiality, privacy, security, accessibility, and data governance expectations.
Provide recommendations and actionable insights based on analytical findings and assist in the development of data-informed strategies and initiatives.
Stay current on developments in business intelligence, data engineering, analytics, artificial intelligence, and responsible data practices; recommend practical improvements when appropriate.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related field.
Two or more years of progressive experience in data analytics, business systems analysis, enterprise reporting, business intelligence, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated expertise in requirements-gathering methodologies, including stakeholder interviews, process mapping, use-case development, and workflow analysis, and in translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications for reporting, dashboards, data models, and data solutions.
Two or more years of hands-on experience with Power BI or other similar tools, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), semantic model design, dashboard prototyping, iteration, deployment, and ongoing optimization across the full BI development lifecycle.
Two or more years of experience with data modeling and the design of efficient, analytics-ready data structures.
Proficiency with SQL and experience extracting, transforming, validating, and analyzing structured and semi-structured data; familiarity with unstructured data is beneficial.
Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, relational and dimensional data models, ETL/ELT frameworks, and cloud data platform concepts, preferably within the Azure ecosystem, such as Data Lake, Synapse, Fabric, or comparable technologies.
Proven experience collaborating with data engineering teams to refine data pipelines, validate data quality, support data governance, troubleshoot data flow issues, and deliver scalable analytics solutions.
Experience planning and executing system, data, integration, and User Acceptance Testing, including issue tracking and resolution validation.
Ability to create high-quality business and technical requirements, data dictionaries, process documentation, test plans, source-to-target mappings, and user guides, with strong attention to detail and version control.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to transform complex datasets into clear findings and actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional discovery sessions, build alignment, and support decision-making.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities, work independently and collaboratively, and adapt in a dynamic environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in higher education and familiarity with academic or administrative data domains.
Experience with Python or R for data preparation, automation, statistical analysis, or selective advanced analytics use cases.
Experience with Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, data lakehouse or warehouse platforms, Git-based version control, and deployment workflows.
Familiarity with data privacy, security, governance, and compliance requirements associated with institutional or student data.
Experience applying predictive analytics or machine learning techniques to well-defined business problems, including evaluation and communication of model limitations.
Relevant certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, data engineering, data analytics, or related technologies.


Work Environment


This position requires working on-site several days a month and is not available as a fully remote role.
Typical office setting with extensive computer-based work.
May require occasional travel across campus for meetings and other work-related events.


Pay Transparency

At Bentley we offer a “total rewards” package designed to attract, motivate, retain, and reward our employees. This includes competitive compensation, robust benefits, career development and opportunities, generous paid time off, workplace flexibility and a positive, engaging employee experience. In alignment with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Act and our commitment to equity and transparency, we’re sharing the salary grade range for this role. The grade range is based on market data and the scope of responsibilities. Final pay will depend on your experience, education, and other relevant qualifications.

Salary Grade Range

$67,960 - $113,126 per year

If you have questions about the salary grade range or need additional information, please contact us at GA_HR_Employment@bentley.edu.

Bentley University requires references checks and may conduct other pre-employment screening.

DIVERSITY STATEMENT

Bentley University strives to create a campus community that welcomes the exchange of ideas, and fosters a culture that values differences and views them as a strength in our community.

Bentley University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, building strength through diversity. The University is committed to building a community of talented students, faculty and staff who reflect the diversity of global business. We strongly encourage applications from persons from underrepresented groups, individuals with disabilities, covered veterans and those with diverse experiences and backgrounds.

Klaviyo is looking for a Lead Customer Intelligence Analyst to join our growing Customer Insights & Analytics team. In this role, you will partner closely with CX stakeholders and data scientists to design new measurement systems, lead ambiguous analytical investigations, and help build the connected customer-intelligence layer behind Klaviyo's health scoring, personas, and experience-impact work. Design and build the Goals Measurement Frameworks & Benchmarks for initiatives and pilots across the CX org - providing a standard way to define, baseline, and track goal attainment across programs.

5–8 years of experience owning analytical problems end-to-end: from framing the business question, through analysis, to influencing stakeholders and operationalizing the solution.
