Title: Senior Strategy Analyst
Description:
Red Oak is a joint venture between two Fortune 20 leading healthcare companies, CVS Health and Cardinal Health, responsible for securing generic pharmaceuticals for both organizations. Pharmaceutical Sourcing team is comprised of industry experts, strategists, and entrepreneurial thinkers who apply innovative strategies to bring generic pharmaceuticals to market more efficiently.




Enjoy the best of both worlds with our hybrid schedule! Work from the comfort of home on Mondays and Fridays and join the team in our welcoming office space on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays for collaboration and connection.




Position Summary:

Red Oak is seeking a data analyst for the Strategy & Analytics team to design Tableau/Salesforce dashboards, manage SQL databases, automate processes in Python, build data pipelines, and perform at hoc analytics to inform daily generic pharmaceutical sourcing strategy as well as longer-term decisions made by the Executive Leadership Team. Success in this role requires strong analytics skills, experience with key data tools, and the ability to work collaboratively across business functions. Experience working in the industry (e.g., pharmaceuticals, healthcare, etc.) is also a plus. The Senior Analyst will have the opportunity to learn about an important segment in the healthcare space at one of the most innovative companies in the industry.

Responsibilities:

1.) Analytics & Insights

Understand how product, supplier, and industry dynamics may impact Red Oak Sourcing
Perform ad hoc quantitative analyses across a variety of topics, as well as oversee recurring deliverables
Compile data and information from multiple sources and translate into meaningful insights
Design and create new Tableau dashboards and visualizations as needed
Communicate findings through appropriate tools (e.g., slide presentations, Excel or reports)




2.) Data Infrastructure

Learn the fundamentals of Red Oak Sourcing’s proprietary data infrastructure
Collect, clean, validate, and process data
Lead change-management initiatives to help adopt new information assets (e.g., Salesforce)
Design data pipelines to integrate different data sources into Red Oak Sourcing’s databases
Develop ETL and storage approaches that ensure ready access to necessary data




3.) Cross-functional Support

Meet regularly with business users to better understand their needs, and educate them on existing tools
Drive various projects across the organization, such as design sprints and quarterly board meetings
Support supplier meetings with dynamic portfolio assessments across a variety of metrics
Execute review of generic portfolio (e.g., identify cost savings, forecast potential changes in product dynamics, model changes in purchasing methodologies, etc.)
Partner cross-functionally to address business needs and create efficiencies




4.) Executive Presentations

Conduct extensive research on subjects pertaining to business and regulatory environments
Build compelling visuals that break complex ideas into digestible fragments
Develop clear and concise narratives that guide the audience through the presentation
Deliver presentations that focus on engaging the audience




Qualifications:

Expertise in key analytics and data visualization tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau and Salesforce
Proficiency in Python and basic understanding of statistical methods (sampling, regression, distributions, etc.)
2-3 years of experience in a related field (e.g., healthcare analytics, data science, statistics etc.)
A bachelor’s degree in quantitative or technical field preferred (e.g., data science, applied analytics, statistics, operations research, mathematics, engineering, etc.)
Experience with web scraping and process automation
Experience with relational databases and knowledge of database management fundamentals
Expertise in building PowerPoint presentations preferred
Exposure to other programming languages is a plus (e.g. R)
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
Ability to connect disparate data and information to identify themes and trends
Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to clearly present results of complex analyses

Title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack (Strategic Revenue Insights)
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Revenue Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About The Role

We’re looking for intelligent, driven professionals to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team is responsible for comprehensive analyses, reporting, and data solutions to support and grow our Revenue segments.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem solving skills, the ability to craft comprehensive narratives for both internal and external stakeholders, and produce tools and solutions to scale data usage with Revenue. In addition to analytical rigor, the ideal candidate has strong interpersonal skills to work proactively within the organization and with clients to drive forward recommendations.

What You’ll Do

Optimize decisions and execution with analyses, and communicate to internal and external partners


Be a strategic partner with our Client Success and Marketplace Teams as the data SME for respective Revenue segments and merchants for their point-of-sale and Marketplace business
Create business cases, insights, and dashboards as well as handle experiments to engage Affirm’s external merchant base; demonstrating Affirm’s value proposition and product performance
Create internal analyses to assess Revenue performance, drive recommendations, and inform critical decisions; using insights to serve segment strategy and execution


Scale impact


Standardize common use cases, provide the analytics infrastructure, and automate analyses and dashboards to scale decisions and execution within Revenue and with top external merchants


Own comprehensive analytics solution


Define KPIs, performance benchmarks, and methodologies, including identifying and working with unstructured and structured data sources (in-house and third-party) to enable solutions and generate actionable insights
Provide project and analytics guidance to a cross-functional team, acting as the analytics point of contact
Propose, monitor, and contextualize experiment design and execution to drive optimizations of Affirm’s GTM efforts, empirically quantify the value of Affirm to our prospective merchants, and upsell enhanced offers to existing merchants


What We Look For


5+ years of experience in an analytically-driven role (consulting, finance, analytics, etc.)
Strong working knowledge of SQL, data visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Looker, Tableau). Understanding or a demonstrated aptitude to learn Python is a plus
Demonstrated aptitude in leveraging AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
Exceptional problem-solving skills, including ability to operate in ambiguity and establishing analytical frameworks to apply to business problems
Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations, such as aligning stakeholders, or choosing the most impactful data to drive decisions
Ability to communicate effectively, and craft compelling narratives to influence business and technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization, internally and externally
Strong organization and execution skills, including ability to operate independently and drive multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously to drive business goals
Prior track record in building successful cross-functional relationships with partners internally and externally
Self-starter and a track record of successfully driving projects from end to end (from building strategy to implementation)
Passion and drive to disrupt both the retail and lending industry for the better
Enough laziness to find a faster way to do your least favorite tasks
Humility and a team player - you go out of your way to help teammates


Nice to Have


Knowledge of the FinTech or Payments industry
Prior experience performing data analytics for marketplace platforms
Demonstrated aptitude in AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)


Pay Grade - M

Equity Grade - 8

Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $164,000 - $224,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

Title: Business Analyst II (Commercial, Wholesale)
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring an Analyst II to join the Commercial Analytics team, with a primary focus on supporting our growing omni-channel business. In this role, you will own reporting and analysis that help explain performance across retail partners, products, and markets, partnering directly with commercial stakeholders to identify opportunities for growth and inform decision-making. You will also contribute to cross-functional analyses spanning Wholesale, Digital Commerce, and Marketing, connecting channel-level insights to the broader commercial picture.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Responsibilities


Own recurring reporting and analysis of wholesale performance across partners, products, and regions, including the metric definitions that support consistent and trusted decision-making.
Analyze retailer and partner performance, including sell-through trends, inventory position, pricing, and promotions, proactively surfacing trends, risks, and growth opportunities to commercial stakeholders.
Develop and maintain the datasets and data models that power wholesale reporting, validating data against source systems and resolving discrepancies to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Lead analyses end to end, from framing business questions with stakeholders and identifying the right analytical approach to translating findings into clear recommendations.
Contribute to cross-functional analyses spanning Wholesale, Digital Commerce, and Marketing, bringing the wholesale perspective and connecting channel performance to broader commercial trends.
Build and improve dashboards and automated reporting that reduce manual analysis, increase visibility into business performance, and enable stakeholders to access recurring insights independently.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience.
2+ years of experience in business analytics or a similar analytical role; experience with retail, wholesale, e-commerce, consumer products, or related commercial data is a plus.
Strong SQL skills, including experience working with large transactional datasets and translating business questions into rigorous analyses and actionable insights.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting using business intelligence tools such as Sigma or similar platforms.
Demonstrated ability to distill complex data into clear, actionable insights and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-starting and collaborative approach, with the ability to independently drive analytical work in a fast-moving environment.
High attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable, and trusted analysis.
Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $125,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. Job Description

Are you passionate about using your analytical skills to derive insights and drive business strategy and success? Are you intrigued by being able to formulate the full picture by tying together seemingly disparate data points from multiple sources (e.g., customer attributes and behaviors, transactional history, call transcripts, digital activity, business financials) into one cohesive story? Are you ready to drive experimentation and strategic insights to optimize every aspect of the customer’s experience?

If yes, we want you to join our forward-thinking team and make a real-world difference for Fidelity’s 40 million individual investors.

The Team

We are seeking a creative and collaborative analytics professional with expertise in data-driven and hypothesis-based insights. As a member of the Customer Knowledge and Strategic Insights (CKSI) team, you will play a pivotal role in a dynamic group. You will partner closely with stakeholders across the business, working with agile, interdisciplinary teams that possess diverse skills in analytics, engineering, data science, marketing, product development, and more. Your insights will drive initiatives that optimize and personalize the Fidelity experience.

The Role

As a key analytics partner, this role will generate actionable insights that inform product strategy. Success requires leveraging data, analytics, and market intelligence to identify emerging trends, uncover growth opportunities, and tell a story of customer experience using data to inform long-term strategic decision-making. The individual in this role will be able to translate a business need or question into a hypothesis that can be validated via data analysis or experimentation. The position offers a unique opportunity to influence critical decisions that shape the future of wealth, planning, advisory, and insurance solutions, while accelerating the organization's shift toward a more data-driven and customer-centric operating model.

This is an individual contributor role.

The Skills You Bring


A cross-functional collaborator who can work across a team with diverse skills and abilities and find success for Fidelity and our customers.
Demonstrating a mix of analytical skills, you always focus on business use cases and customer needs.
Ability to use data to tell a story of customer experience, highlighting both successes and friction points to inform future initiatives and strategies.
Ability to translate a business need or question into a hypothesis that can be validated via experimentation or data analysis.
Ability to manipulate and synthesize data from large and sometimes unwieldy data into a cohesive story that delivers insights to a broad audience in a simple, clear, and actionable way.
Natural intellectual curiosity, initiative, and love for learning new skills and capabilities.


The Expertise We’re Looking For


6 plus years of experience generating analytical insights to drive business actions, including experience with a range of analytical tools and programming languages such as SQL, Python, R, etc.
Experience using and querying big data technologies such as Snowflake, Athena, etc.
Experience in designing and developing dashboards and reports by using Tableau, Power BI etc.
Experience with digital analytics using tools such as Adobe analytics
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative / technical field such as Data or Business Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or Finance. MBA or MS degree a plus


The Value You Deliver


Continuously improving data analytics and insights capabilities and spreading that knowledge and expertise throughout the organization
Delivering data-driven and actionable insights to enable objective, informed business, and product decisions


Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

The base salary range for this position is $107,000-216,000 USD per year.

Placement in the range will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

Base salary is only part of the total compensation package. Depending on the position and eligibility requirements, the offer package may also include bonus or other variable compensation.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet your evolving needs and help you live your best life at work and at home. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage and emotional well-being support, market-leading retirement, generous paid time off and parental leave, charitable giving employee match program, and educational assistance including student loan repayment, tuition reimbursement, and learning resources to develop your career. Note, the application window closes when the position is filled or unposted.

Title: Senior Analyst, Enterprise Analytics
Description:
Location: Cambridge, MA / Hybrid

(This role requires working in-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)

About us:

EverQuote is a leading AI-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty

insurance entities, enabling the market-defining insurance carriers and thousands of agents to

maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets

and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage

consumers to grow market share.

Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a

group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to

drive real-world impact and do the best work of your career, you’ve found your home. We move

fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the

role for you.

About the role:

As Senior Analyst, Enterprise Analytics, you will work as part of the team overseeing our

customers’ performance and spending in our marketplace business. You will be the owner of

one more significant customer campaigns, identifying optimization opportunities that produce

value for both EverQuote and our customers. You will work cross-functionally with Product,

Engineering, Data Science, and Business Development to convert these ideas into realized

value.

About you:

You are a talented analyst and communicator. You enjoy finding inefficiency using data, but are

considered enough in your analysis to know when to flip into execution to capture an

opportunity. You have a knack for explaining complex concepts to a variety of stakeholders, both

internal and external. You envision yourself growing into a leader of analysts or a P&L owner as

you progress in your career.

What you'll do:


Campaign optimization: Become the primary analyst on multiple customer campaigns,


responsible for understanding their performance in detail. Identify opportunities to

improve pricing rationality and customer outcomes through campaign optimizations, and

either execute these directly or product clear recommendations to BD and customers to

do so.


Capability-building: contribute to team-wide capabilities that improve the quality or


velocity of common customer or marketplace dynamics analyses


Stakeholder collaboration: Build deep relationships with Enterprise BD, Product, and


Engineering to effectively convert surfaced ideas into action, and with other teams within

Analytics to ensure recommendations support broader company strategy

What you bring to the team:


2+ years of experience in Analytics or a related domain, with a focus on quantitative


business problem-solving


Strong SQL skills; able to independently pull, shape, and analyze large datasets


(Snowflake a plus)


Solid experimentation fundamentals: significance, power, incrementality measurement,


confound control


Clear communication with both technical and executive stakeholders


Nice to have:


Experience in the insurance industry, digital performance marketing, or marketplace


businesses - these experiences are valuable but not required, and a great candidate will

learn these on the job

The base salary actually offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the

applicant's job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The

base salary for this full-time role is $90,000 - $115,000.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable

cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing

benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role.

Your recruiter can provide more details about additional compensation components, such as

OTE structure, bonus targets, or equity, during the hiring process.

EverQuote is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without

regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry,

age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or a pregnancy-related condition, veteran or

military status, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are available

for applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, upon request.

For more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.

Job Description

This role provides an exciting opportunity for a talented individual looking to looking to flex their analytical prowess in combination with driving analysis and insights into the SUS portfolio in support of BU reporting and decision making. As an integral member of the SIS SUS R&D team this role is responsible for supporting global SIS Sustaining (SUS) R&D Operations.

This role works with the Sustaining R&D Operations Leader, the SUS PELs (Project Execution Leaders), PMs and the regional SUS R&D leaders by performing ad hoc analyses and providing tactical support on a broad range of projects of strategic importance to the SIS SUS org among other initiatives as needs arise.

Job Duties


SUS Operations (70%)
Primarily responsible for collecting, synthesizing, analyzing and managing data from multiple sources (including project and CAPA labor and budget actuals and forecast) to support SPT (Sustaining Prioritization Teams) and SGB (Sustaining Governance Board) presentations and BU level decision making through relevant and actionable insights and reporting with an understanding of the drivers and project implications using your tools expertise to analyze and evaluate data using Excel including, pivot tables, queries, equations, etc.
Work with multiple stakeholders including PELs (Project Execution Leaders), PMs, GRDLs, gPMO and CAPA governance and process team members among others, managing multiple projects simultaneously with minimal direction.
Develop and support SUS org KPI reporting in support of SGB meetings including monthly PPT reports to key stakeholders through the preparation supporting dashboards and scorecards in a user-friendly manner including visualization BI tools (e.g. PowerBI) and Portfolio tools (e.g. Sensei IQ).
Develop visual representations of gathered complex data/relationships to convey key information succinctly and unambiguously. Ensure that the methodology and assumptions used to develop the output are clearly documented, accurate, and repeatable.
Partners with other analysts (e.g. gPMO, CAPA) and project managers to build and enhance repeatable processes and best practices.
Support collaboration with the Strategy team to ensure alignment with the SFBP (Strategic & Financial Business Process) team including data alignment and accuracy.
Finance (15%)
Support SPT financial reporting and analysis for PJ budgets and CAPA (labor & expense) in collaboration with global finance leads.
Work with the SUS PMO and finance teams to roll-up project and CAPA related financials to a concise, BU level report with insights.
Support CTO Office and otherprojects including Sustainability, Materials and Tariff projects (15%)
Lead and/or support global CTO level initiatives as appropriate.

Job Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor’s degree required in engineering, finance, business, economics or similar quantitative fields.
Minimum of 8 years of experience in a combination of data and analytics projects, R&D sustaining projects or operations inclusive of quality projects, portfolio management and analysis and/or business process development.
Financial and business acumen and mindset are required.
Advanced mastery of Microsoft Office (Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint).
Excellent analytical and complex problem-solving skills with proven expertise in creating reports and tools to analyse and evaluate data using Excel, pivot tables, queries, equations, etc.
Ability to synthesize information from multiple data sources, draw relevant and actionable conclusions, and handle multiple projects simultaneously with minimal direction.
Proven track record of developing and communicating data analysis insights and results to assist decision-making for leadership.
Demonstrates strong organizational and planning skills; strong interpersonal and relationship building skills with ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Excellent time management & project management skills.
Motivated individual with the ability to work independently and in teams on tasks and projects with limited supervision and with a high degree of personal initiative and drive.
Ability to support global meetings / discussions (e.g., schedule flexibility to support meetings with teams in Germany (CET) and Japan (JST)).


Preferred:


PMP Certification a plus.
Prior project management knowledge and expertise preferred.
Medical device experience preferred.
Global experience interfacing with offshore teams and initiatives is preferable.
Experience working in an international matrixed organization with great collaboration skills preferred.
Advanced capabilities in visualization BI tools (PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) and Portfolio tools (Sensei IQ) preferred.

Description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

Financial & Data Analyst (Customer Solutions Group)

We are seeking a motivated Financial Analyst to support the Customer Solutions Group (CSG), with a primary focus on financial reporting, data analytics, and commercial finance. This role will work with finance and business stakeholders to strengthen financial discipline, improve visibility into business performance, and translate financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights.

The analyst will also play a key role in advancing AI enablement initiatives across Finance and CSG operations. This includes assisting with use-case identification, improving data readiness, supporting responsible adoption, and helping integrate approved solutions into recurring workflows. This is an excellent opportunity for a developing finance professional who combines strong financial acumen with curiosity about data, technology, and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities


Financial Reporting: Prepare and maintain recurring financial reports that provide clear visibility into business performance. Support variance analysis and communicate key results, trends, and risks to finance and business stakeholders.
Revenue Forecasting & Consolidation: Support the revenue forecasting calendar and consolidation process, partnering with internal and external stakeholders to help deliver accurate, timely, and decision-useful forecasts.
Reporting Governance: Support the Leadership Team in managing reporting cadence, governance processes, metric definitions, and standards to promote consistent and reliable financial information.
Data Analytics & Visualization: Analyze large and varied datasets to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities. Build and enhance dashboards, reporting views, and self-service analytics that improve decision-making across Finance and CSG operations.
AI Enablement: Partner with Finance and CSG stakeholders to identify, prioritize, test, and scale practical AI use cases, including forecast insights, management reporting, variance analysis, workflow automation, and knowledge access.
Data Readiness & Controls: Help improve data quality, documentation, metric consistency, and validation controls required for trusted analytics and AI-enabled solutions. Promote appropriate governance, human review, and responsible use of financial data and AI outputs.
Process Automation & Continuous Improvement: Map recurring finance processes and identify opportunities to reduce manual work using automation, AI, and standardized reporting. Help measure adoption, efficiency gains, and business impact.
IT & Data Interface: Work with Finance, IT, data, and technology teams to document business needs, translate them into reporting and automation requirements, and support solution testing and implementation


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field
2-4 years of relevant experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Accounting, business analytics, or a related area
Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Advanced Excel skills and experience creating clear, executive-ready PowerPoint materials
Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Qlik, or similar platforms
Experience with enterprise planning and finance systems such as SAP, Anaplan, or similar tools preferred
Exposure to generative AI, AI-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or data modeling, is preferred but not required
Ability to work with finance and technology partners to translate business questions into data, reporting, automation, or AI requirements


Skills & Capabilities


Strong attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex financial and operational data into clear insights
Business-first mindset with an interest in connecting analytics and AI capabilities to practical Finance outcomes
Curiosity about emerging technologies and willingness to experiment, learn, and help others adopt new ways of working
Ability to evaluate data and AI outputs critically, validate results, and communicate assumptions and limitations
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships within Finance and across functions
Proactive ownership, sound judgment, and commitment to continuous improvement


Why This Role


Exposure to business and Finance leadership across CSG
Opportunity to contribute to how data analytics, automation, and AI are applied across Finance and CSG operations
Broad development across forecasting, reporting, commercial finance, business partnership, and digital enablement
Opportunity for continued growth and future rotation within the Finance organization

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position can be based in the Washington D.C or Chicago, IL office.




Position Summary

NAR is seeking a Data Analyst to help deliver data-driven insights, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled products that support decision-making across the organization. This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related technical role.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Data Analyst - Finance
Description:
The Data Analyst provides analytical and organizational support to the Finance operations/management. They are proficient in data processing and report development, as well as scripting languages, including Python and SQL. Capable of creating, developing, testing, and deploying highly adaptive tools and reports used to support business. Responsible for conducting data analysis, analyzing trends, and creating visualizations and dashboards. The Data Analyst will be expected to understand established procedures and recommend improvements. The Data Analyst can self-manage tasks, projects, and complete them in a timely manner under general supervision.

Job Duties


Under general supervision develop SQL scripts and long-term reporting using a variety of data analysis tools / languages (SQL, Teradata, Tableau, and Excel). Identify and analyze trends with root cause analysis while providing solutions.
Provide ad hoc data analysis in a variety of source systems and using a variety of data analysis tools/ languages (SQL, Teradata, Tableau, Excel, Access).
Design, build, and maintain a predictive churn model. Develop internal reports on key indicators of churn, including ad-hoc reports as needed. Organize projects clearly with accurate plan for speed of delivery of initiatives.
Document existing and newly created processes for implementation in production systems.
Meet with Team and Management concerning semi-complex production reporting and enhancements. Provides detail regarding challenges and offer solutions and recommendations.
Collaborate with other Business Units such as Big Data, Marketing, and Product Management to accomplish common goals and objectives.
This position operates under close guidance of a Senior resource. Work requires extensive knowledge in AWS, Snowflake, and SQL databases with data mining knowledge as well as data visualization through Tableau. Work regularly requires the exercise of discretion and independent judgment in areas such as:
Querying large data sets, validating data, and performing User Acceptance Testing.
Developing specialized reports/dashboards.
Troubleshooting data issues.
Developing solutions to complex data issues.
Formulation of calculations to compute incentives, goals, forecasts.


Qualifications


Bachelors Equivalent combination of education and experience.
1-3 years Experience in a traditional data or analytics corporate environment.
1-3 years Experience in providing qualitative or quantitative data compilation, analysis and reporting.
1-3 years Experience with manipulating data with SQL, Python, R or related technologies.
Professional verbal and written communication skills required.
Strong SQL skills with data mining knowledge.
Advanced Excel skills (incl. VBA, macros, complex calculations, etc.).
Tableau preferred.
Python preferred.
Experience in statistical churn model a plus.
Able to rapidly learn new processes, databases, applications.


The starting pay range for this position is:

$74,500.00 - $99,500.00

Additionally, for full time positions, you will be eligible to participate in our incentive program based upon the achievement of organization, team and personal performance.

Remarkable benefits:


Health coverage for medical, dental, vision
401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension
Tuition assistance
Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs
Paid parental leave
Wellness programs
Employee discounts (membership, insurance,


travel, entertainment, services and more!)

Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques
Concevoir et fournir des rapports, des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et des visualisations, en garantissant l'intégrité des données provenant de multiples sources
Extraire, compiler et agréger des données issues de multiples sources afin de les présenter sous un format simple et intuitif, qui sera utilisé dans les rapports et les présentations
Compiler les exigences relatives aux rapports récurrents en vue de leur automatisation dans Power BI et participer à leur test une fois développés
Élaborer et exécuter des plans de test, résoudre les problèmes et améliorer en continu les rapports et tableaux de bord BI
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes techniques internes (par exemple, Digital Information) pour garantir la livraison en temps voulu des modèles de données, une communication claire et la résolution des obstacles
Contribuer à la production de rapports ponctuels et ad hoc basés sur des données provenant de différentes sources
Travailler en collaboration avec différents services pour garantir l'exactitude des rapports
Travailler simultanément sur plusieurs initiatives et hiérarchiser les tâches en fonction des livrables à venir

Ce poste exige un grand souci du détail, la capacité à synthétiser des informations et à les présenter sous une forme simple et claire, tant au niveau de la mise en page que de la présentation, tout en sachant les communiquer de manière claire et concise.



Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, finance ou gestion d'entreprise avec une formation en analyse opérationnelle, ou expérience équivalente
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente
Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du reporting ou de l'analyse
Excellentes compétences analytiques et de présentation
Solides compétences organisationnelles
Bonnes compétences en gestion du temps et en hiérarchisation des priorités
Orientation client
Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais stricts
Motivation à travailler dans un environnement dynamique
Capacité à travailler aussi bien en équipe qu'en autonomie
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite des interactions avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)



Votre expertise technique :

Connaissances avancées de Power BI Desktop et intermédiaires de Power BI Service
Maîtrise approfondie du langage DAX (Data Analytics Expressions)
Expérience en extraction et manipulation de données à l'aide de requêtes SQL, de la fonction « Recherche avancée » de CRM et des rapports Power BI existants
Bonne maîtrise des concepts liés aux bases de données et au stockage de données
Connaissances avancées de la suite Microsoft (Word, Excel et PowerPoint)
La connaissance des systèmes CRM et Finance & Operations (MS Dynamics 365) est un atout



Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être



Si vous souhaitez savoir à quoi ressemble l'environnement de travail chez Genetec, voici le lien vers notre vidéo d'entreprise: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA



Nous savons que la diversité des parcours et des expériences apporte une grande valeur à nos équipes. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases nous vous encourageons à postuler - votre profil pourrait nous surprendre!



Merci pour votre candidature, mais veuillez noter que seul(e)s les candidat(e)s sélectionné(e)s seront contacté(e)s. Les chasseurs de têtes et les agences de recrutement ne sont pas autorisés à soumettre des CV par l'intermédiaire de ce site web ou directement aux gestionnaires.

Job Overview:

Genetec is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst for its Customer Experience (CX) organization. We are seeking a dynamic and responsive individual who can thrive in a fast-paced and lively environment and transform complex data into actionable insights. 

In this role, the candidate will support the CX Shared Services (CXSS) team as a key contributor to the entire lifecycle of reporting and analytics efforts—from gathering requirements and extracting data to creating and delivering automated reports. This role will help Genetec's CX organization distinguish itself by providing its team members with detailed metrics, in-depth and accurate data analysis and calculations, and clear presentations that drive decision-making. These reports, analyses, and presentations will be closely related to the performance of our CX operations, with data sourced from databases across different systems (CRM, ERP, Web Portal, IVR, Chat, etc.). This role requires strong skills in data integration, validation, and interpretation. 



Your day at a glance:

Gather requirements for analysis, reports, and presentations from various stakeholders within the CX organization and translate them into technical specifications
Design and deliver reports, KPIs, and visualizations, ensuring data integrity across multiple sources
Extract, compile, and aggregate data from multiple data sources to be presented in an easy and intuitive format, which will be displayed in reports and presentations
Compile the requirements of recurring reports for their automation in Power BI and assist with their testing once developed
Develop and execute test plans, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve BI reports and dashboards
Collaborate with stakeholders and internal technical teams (e.g., Digital Information) to ensure timely delivery of data models, clear communication, and resolution of blockers
Support the generation of timely and ad-hoc reports based on data from different sources
Work in collaboration with different departments to ensure accuracy of the reports
Work on multiple initiatives at once and prioritize tasks according to the upcoming deliverables

This position requires great attention to detail, the ability to harmonize information and transform it into a simple and easy-to-understand format in terms of both layout and presentation, while also being able to communicate it clearly and concisely. 



What makes you a great fit:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, or Business with an operational analysis background, or equivalent experience  
5+ years of relevant working experience  
3+ years of experience working in reporting or analytics  
Excellent analytical and presentation skills 
Strong organizational skills 
Possess good time management and prioritization skills 
Customer-oriented  
Be able to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines  
Motivated to work in a fast-paced environment  
Be able to work in a team environment as well as independently  
Fluent in French and English, both verbal and written



Your technical expertise:

 Advanced Power BI Desktop and intermediate Power BI Service knowledge 
Strong proficiency in DAX (Data Analytics Expressions) 
Experience with data extraction and manipulation with the use of SQL queries, CRM Advanced Find, and existing Power BI reports 
Familiar with database and data warehousing concepts 
Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft suite (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) 
Knowledge of CRM and Finance & Operations systems (MS Dynamics 365) is an asset 



Let's talk perks!

Attractive compensation package
Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule
Subsidized meals in our amazing Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Free, unlimited coffee and fruits
Private, free parking for all employees
Onsite fitness facility with personal trainer, and multiple wellness and health workshops



If you'd like to see what the work environment at Genetec looks like, check out our corporate video: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA



We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!



Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Title: Data Analyst IV - Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine
Description:
About FIU

Florida International University is a Top 50, preeminent public research university with 55,000 students from all 50 states and more than 140 countries, as well as an alumni network of more than 340,000. Located in the global city of Miami, the university offers more than 200 degree programs at the undergraduate, graduate and professional levels, including medicine and law. FIU faculty are leaders in their fields and include National Academy members, Fulbright Scholars and MacArthur Genius Fellows. A Carnegie R1 institution, FIU drives impactful research in environmental resilience, health and technology and innovation. Home to the Wall of Wind and Institute of Environment, FIU stands at the forefront of discovery and innovation. With a focus on student success, economic mobility and community engagement, FIU is redefining what it means to be a public research university.

Job Summary

The Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine is currently seeking a Data Analyst IV to join our team of professionals.

Duties Include:


Provides support to the quantitative and qualitative data analysis of learner data to support excellence in education.
Makes recommendations regarding design and data collection methodology for clinical assessments and simulation/performance-based assessments in collaboration with key leaders for the Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine (HWCOM).
Responsible for data organization, maintenance of assessment database, statistical analysis, general interpretation and reporting of results to appropriate stakeholders.
Collects and analyzes data to support course revisions and curriculum planning.
Develops data collection and analysis methodology, including defining in detailed data requirements, data sources, and proper data collections procedures for statistical analysis.
Develops and implements data collection quality assurance procedures to ensure validity and reliability of results.
Collects data using appropriate methods (e.g.: checklists, global rating scales, surveys, forms, questionnaires,etc).
Generates reports, charts, tables, and presentations as appropriate for the reporting of data and outcomes to individuals, offices, and committees.
Builds structures as needed to capture data for longitudinal reporting.
Serves as a resource for faculty conducting medical education research regarding data issues such as appropriate collection and entry methods as well as data quality.
Collaborates with HWCOM IT to identify requirements and parameters for data delivery and specifications.
Serves as a key member of the Assessment Committee and the Program Evaluation Committee. Responsible for quality control of data compilation and analysis, results interpretation, visualization and reporting for the Assessment committee, a sub-committee of the Curriculum Committee that reviews all assessments for quality, effectiveness and consistency throughout period one, two, and three.
Leads the planning, development, and implementation of a data warehouse (in collaboration with the HWCOM IT department, Office of Medical Education, and the Office of Students Affairs) that will house student performance data as well as data across the Office of Academic Affairs and Office of Student Affairs that is integral to program evaluation and strategic planning, in order to improve tracking of performance metrics and ensure we are meeting outcomes.
Performs other related duties as required or directed. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in an appropriate area of specialization and six (6) years of appropriate experience or a Master's degree in an appropriate area of specialization and four (4) years of appropriate experience.

Desired Qualifications

Bachelors and/or Master's degree in Education, Educational Psychology, Quantitative Psychology preferred.

Analytical and statistical expertise in predominantly clinical and performance-based assessment (ie: work-place based assessment, OSCEs), student outcomes, program reviews and teaching evaluations.

Working knowledge of common statistical variables, including but not limited to variable types, scale types, descriptive statistics, and basic statistical inferences (t-test, z-test, chi-square, regression) and statistical packages such as SPSS, and SAS that support these analyses.

Experience in assessment and performance-based assessment evaluation of programs required. Experience in assessing medical education programs preferred.

Demonstrated ability to communicate ideas and results effectively.

Experience with Qualtrics and BI Dashboarding

Job Details

We are looking for a highly skilled and passionate Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team in the HealthTech industry. 7. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to continuously improve our data systems and processes.

Qualifications:

1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related experience.
2. At least 7 years of experience in a data analysis role, with strong communication skills and ability to tell a story with the data for business impact.
3. Proficiency in Tableau or another data visualization tool like PowerBI.
4. Proficiency with SQL. Python is a plus.
5. Solid experience in ETL processes and data warehouse systems is a plus
6. Strong understanding of data modeling, reporting, data cleaning, and data mining techniques.
7. Strong English communication skills with the ability to present data and insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. We have a variety of business units with exciting and meaningful work waiting for you, including Communications, HR, Legal and Corporate Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, and Real Estate. If you are considering your next step, we have exciting opportunities waiting for you. Come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!

An exciting opportunity exists to join as a Senior Data Analyst in the Wireless Service & Equipment Finance team. This position will be responsible for creating and maintaining Tableau dashboard that including dashboard design, creation, master data file building, data mining and measuring service & equipment revenue /usage KPIs and be able to be as story teller. Candidates will work very closely with various teams to provide value-added analysis on Wireless Revenue.

The Sr. Data Analyst will be based in Toronto and will provide expert data management to Wireless Service & Equipment Finance.

What You'll Do


Design, develop, enhance and maintain Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards supporting Wireless Service & Equipment Finance reporting and performance management.
Develop and maintain master datasets and reporting data layers using Databricks, SQL and Python, including data extraction, transformation, integration and validation from multiple data sources.
Build and automate weekly and monthly financial scorecards, dashboards and management reports, providing clear insights into performance trends and key business drivers.
Analyze large and complex datasets across multiple source systems to evaluate wireless subscriber, revenue, equipment, usage and other financial/business KPIs.
Translate business and Finance requirements into scalable data models, queries, dashboards and reporting solutions.
Write and optimize SQL queries and Databricks workflows to extract, join, cleanse, transform and aggregate large datasets for financial reporting and business analysis.
Use Python and SQL to automate recurring data preparation, validation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
Develop visually effective dashboards that enable users to understand performance, identify trends and investigate key drivers.
Perform detailed data validation and reconciliation between source systems, master datasets, financial results and reporting outputs to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Investigate data discrepancies, data quality issues and potential data corruption; identify root causes and work with appropriate teams to implement solutions.
Support Financial Analysis, Pricing, Commercial Strategy, Marketing and Sales teams by providing reliable datasets, analytical insights and ad-hoc reporting.
Process and analyze data to support business cases, forecasting, performance measurement and ad-hoc analytical requests.
Define data requirements and business rules and ensure data extracts and reporting outputs are complete, accurate and fit for purpose.
Develop and automate financial and statistical analyses using tools such as Databricks, Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau and Power BI.
Partner with Data, Technology and IT teams to identify appropriate source systems, databases and tables and understand upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Present analytical findings to Finance and business stakeholders and translate complex data into clear business stories, key insights and actionable recommendations.


What You'll Bring


3+ years’ experience in data analytics/Business Intelligence, ideally within telecommunications.
Advanced Databricks and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets.
Strong Python and/or PySpark programming and data manipulation experience.
Advanced Tableau dashboard development; Power BI experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of data modeling, transformation, quality, architecture, and data management.
Experience building master datasets, reusable reporting sources, and automated/scalable reporting solutions.
Strong Excel skills, including large datasets and financial analysis.
Experience with statistical, trend, variance, testing, and performance analysis.
University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
Insights-driven, adaptable, collaborative, and customer-focused, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


What's In It For You

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including


Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
Company matching contributions to charities you support


Growth & Development Opportunities


Self-driven career development programs
Rogers First priority in applying to internal roles of interest


Wellness Programs


Employee & family assistance program
Virtual Healthcare
Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
Low or no-cost fitness membership


Our commitment to the environment and diversity


Work for an organization committed to environmental protection
